Safety Physician

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Our Clinical Development model brings the customer and the patient to the center of everything that we do. We are continuously looking for ways to simplify and streamline our work to not only make Syneos Health easier to work with, but to make us easier to work for.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs medical review of adverse events reported for investigational and marketed products
  • Maintains familiarity with MedDRA, WHO-DRL, and safety databases such as ARGUS.
  • Works closely with Safety and Pharmacovigilance (SPVG) colleagues to ensure appropriate medical interpretation and consistency are applied to adverse event case assessment
  • Ensures regulatory and SOP compliance with respect to evaluation, reporting and surveillance of clinical and post-marketing safety information
  • Identifies, communicates and effectively manages potential safety issues
  • Interacts with client’s safety/medical personnel as appropriate
  • Stays abreast of clinical and drug development information relevant to contracted programs
  • Provides medical review and interpretation for aggregate safety reports (e.g. annual safety reports, PSURs, PADERs)
  • Maintains medical and pharmacovigilance expertise through appropriate internal or external continued medical education
  • Assists as a mentor and trainer for other internal safety staff including case processing staff
  • Responsible for performing activities that are in compliance with applicable Corporate and D Departmental Policies, Standard Operating Procedures, Work Instructions and any project specific Operating Guidelines
  • The incumbent should possess M.D., MBBS, D.O.
  • Completed an accredited residency
  • Minimum of one to two (1 to 2) years of experience in clinical practice prefered
  • Minimum of one (1) year of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or device industry working in pharmacovigilance/epidemiology preferred
  • Knowledge of global pharmacovigilance regulations and processes
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint), Visio, email (Outlook), TeamShare (or other management/shared content/workspace), safety databases, and internet.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (proficient in English) as well as in the language required for case processing
  • Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform and influence
  • Ability to travel as necessary (up to 10%)

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

jobs.excerpt: We are mission-driven to advance wellbeing across the Quality of Life ecosystem through impactful leadership.
jobs.description:
We are mission-driven to advance wellbeing across the Quality of Life ecosystem through impactful leadership. Come join us!

THE ROLE

The Senior Associate’s primary role is to manage the initial candidate identification and development process. In addition, the Senior Associate will assist Consultants, Principals, and Senior Partners in generating, managing and/or executing search assignments including potential candidate development, screening and presentation to clients, cultivating and/or maintaining client and candidate relationships.

As a vital member of the search team, you will have the ability to network with professionals and assist them in achieving their career objectives in organizations committed to improving the quality of life, assess a candidate’s skills against a client’s needs, and collaborate with colleagues across the firm.

This position offers a base salary of $85,000 to $110,000.In addition to base salary, this role offers a semi-annual bonus opportunity under a production-based incentive program. With no cap on earnings, the plan provides meaningful earnings to reward strong contributions to business and revenue growth.Salary within our ranges is determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as required by the role, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. WittKieffer offers a full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, life and disability insurances, and generous paid time off.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Actively participate in and/or lead the search process including, but not limited to, working with clients and search committees, sourcing, interviewing, conducting references, negotiating, and closing assignments.

  • Build, manage, and/or nurture client and candidate relationships with a goal of repeat business.

  • Participate in and/or lead client calls and meetings.

  • Prepare materials for client meetings and presentations.

  • Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.

  • Support search consultants in the execution of search engagements. This includes creating search engagement strategies necessary to identify outstanding candidates and then executing the candidate identification and profiling processes through a variety of primary and secondary sources.

  • In conjunction with the search consultant and client, develop an effective and compelling presentation to market the role and client company to prospective candidates. Communicate position profile to potential candidates.

  • Understand the client position needs thoroughly, and execute accordingly, contacting, identifying, and screening candidates for the position "fit," from a content and functional perspective.

  • Participate in candidate development. When appropriate, will manage candidates through the search process, including candidate interviews, candidate presentations, and referencing.

  • Conduct preliminary phone screen evaluations of candidates and assess a candidate's skills against a client's needs through a telephone interview.

  • Proactively network and seek out the candidates in an expeditious and most cost-effective manner.

  • Work closely with lead consultants as well as Research and Data Management.

The Senior Associate will be expected to accomplish the following in the first 12 months:

  • Demonstrate an understanding of the full search process.

  • Demonstrate an understanding of the role a WittKieffer Senior Associate plays in the search process.

  • Carry a full search load (approximately 10 searches).

  • Have the ability to travel as needed.

  • Demonstrate ability to appropriately assess potential candidate eligibility through telephone screening.

  • Be seen by others as collaborative.

  • Live the WittKieffer values.

  • Gain a firm understanding of the industry their practice operates.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor’s degree is required; Master’s strongly preferred.

  • 5+ years' experience in executive search, research capacity, or recruitment or industry related experience.

  • Significant previous experience and skill working with computer systems, databases, email, etc.

  • Strong assessment skills.

  • Strong communication skills (verbal, written, listening).

Critical Competencies:

  • Strong Work Ethic: Search work activities and project outcomes often are defined by criteria outside of a senior associate's span of control. A senior associate's level of effort and thoroughness of process are factors that are proportional to a successful outcome.

  • Team-Based and Collaborative: A successful search involves a team comprised of administrative staff, researchers, data managers, associates, consultants, and other personnel who support operations. It is essential that everyone be aware of the value of each member's role and be quick to award credit.

  • Action/Results Oriented: Focused on the outcome of personal and teamwork; does not get bogged down in process; enjoys working hard and seizing opportunities; pushes self and others for results.

  • Customer Focused: Concerned for and dedicated to satisfying external and/or internal customers; works hard to understand needs of customers and can adjust work style and products accordingly.

  • Priority Setting: Spends own and other's time on what is important; zeroes in on critical few and puts "the many" aside; demonstrates good time management skills.

  • Assessment Skills: Has a nose for talent; can articulate strengths and weaknesses of people after short exposure; can separate performance and potential; makes accurate appraisals of others.

  • Process Management: Manages multiple activities simultaneously; uses resources effectively and efficiently; creates processes to manage workflow and gets more out of fewer resources.

  • Ethics and Values: Models firm values during both bad and good times and reinforces the right values in others.

  • Listening: Attentive and active listener; hears people out; allows others to participate in conversations without dominating; gets the point of what others are saying.

  • Results Oriented: Adherence to identified process is important, but timeliness of work product and search completion within the client's parameters is key.

  • Self-Starter: Each senior associate assumes the role of project manager. An individual more comfortable with being given a systematic timetable will not be successful in this environment where initiative is key to success.

jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous?

L’Alliance pharmaceutique pancanadienne (APP) réunit les gouvernements provinciaux, territoriaux et fédéral dans le but d’accroître et de gérer l’accès à des médicaments utiles sur le plan clinique et rentables. Grâce à des négociations collectives, l’APP a réalisé des économies globales pour les gouvernements (au 1er avril 2025) de 3,94 milliards de dollars par année sur les médicaments de marque et de 935 millions de dollars par année sur les médicaments génériques, pour un total de 4,87 milliards de dollars par année. L’APP offre un environnement de travail entièrement à distance (au Canada).

À propos du poste

La personne titulaire du poste de spécialiste du soutien informatique joue un rôle essentiel en assumant des fonctions primordiales d’assistance en TI et de soutien opérationnel au sein de l’APP afin d’assurer la prestation de services efficaces et en temps opportun de manière à répondre aux priorités et aux objectifs opérationnels fondamentaux de l’organisation. Ce rôle participe aussi à l’amélioration et la fiabilité continue des services de TI et favorise une expérience technologique uniforme à travers l’organisation.

Relevant de la direction des Infrastructures et des projets, ce poste est essentiel soutenir les initiatives d’excellence opérationnelle et assurer un soutien informatique de première ligne harmonieux à nos équipes internes dans un environnement de télétravail.

La personne titulaire du poste de spécialiste du soutien informatique aidera à élaborer les processus opérationnels et les procédures normales d’exploitation tout en aidant au dépannage informatique et à la gestion des biens.

Principales responsabilités

Soutien informatique et opérations

  • Fournir des demandes de soutien interne en matière de TI et des demandes de dépannage de niveau 1 pour les problèmes liés au matériel, aux logiciels, à la connectivité et à l’accès aux comptes.
  • Appuyer les activités de gestion des comptes d’utilisateur, y compris la réinitialisation des mots de passe, l’attribution des groupes et la gestion des autorisations dans Microsoft 365.
  • Aider à l’intégration et au départ du personnel en assurant la fourniture des appareils, des licences et de l’accès aux systèmes.
  • Soutenir les activités de gestion et de conformité des appareils à l’aide d’outils de gestion à distance (p. ex., Intune, RMM Tools).
  • Tenir à jour les inventaires des biens de TI pour le matériel, les licences de logiciels et les accessoires.
  • Fournir un soutien administratif de base pour les applications infonuagiques, dont SharePoint, Teams et Exchange Online.
  • Documenter les problèmes fréquents, les solutions et les procédures courantes de dépannage dans notre base de connaissances.
  • Renvoyer les incidents complexes aux services de soutien de niveau 2 ou 3 appropriés ou à des fournisseurs externes, au besoin.
  • Participer aux initiatives de sensibilisation à la cybersécurité et à la surveillance des systèmes d’extrémité de base et veiller à ce que les systèmes respectent les normes de conformité de base.

Supérieur.e hiérarchique

  • Le poste relève de la direction, Infrastructures et projets.

Qualifications

Études et expérience

  • Diplôme d’études collégiales ou baccalauréat en technologie de l’information, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Plus de cinq années d’expérience pertinente de soutien informatique.
  • Expérience de Power BI, de Power Automate ou de plateformes d’automatisation low‑code.
  • Connaissance des principes de cybersécurité ou participation à un programme de sensibilisation à la sécurité.
  • Expérience du soutien au télétravail et de l’optimisation des environnements de collaboration virtuels.
  • Les certifications en TI comme CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation ou Microsoft 365 Fundamentals sont des atouts.
  • Expérience professionnelle au sein d’organisations soumises à des exigences réglementaires ou de conformité (par ex., RGPD, HIPAA) est considéré un atout.
  • Connaissance des diagrammes SIPOC, de la cartographie des processus ou de l’analyse du flux de travail est considéré un atout.

Connaissances spécialisées

Compétences en soutien informatique

  • Compétences de base en dépannage d’ordinateurs portatifs Windows, d’appareils mobiles (iOS et Android) et de périphériques.
  • Expérience du soutien des services infonuagiques de Microsoft 365, dont Teams, SharePoint, Exchange Online et OneDrive.
  • Connaissance des plateformes de support à distance et des systèmes de gestion d’appareils (p. ex., Intune, Pulseway, TeamViewer).
  • Connaissance des concepts de gestion de l’identité et de l’accès (p. ex., authentification multifacteur, politiques d’accès conditionnel).
  • Exposition aux outils de sécurité des systèmes d’extrémité (p. ex., antivirus, solutions de détection et réponse des terminaux comme Bitdefender ou Crowdstrike).
  • Capacité de transposer des renseignements techniques en conseils faciles à comprendre pour les utilisateurs.trices finaux.ales.

Connaissance de logiciels

  • GSTI / Systèmes de tickets : Zendesk, Freshservice, Zoho Desk, ServiceNow.
  • Suite Microsoft 365 : SharePoint, Teams, Word, Excel, Outlook, Planner et Power Automate (une connaissance de base est un atout).
  • Assistance et gestion d’appareils à distance : Microsoft Intune, RMM Tools, TeamViewer.

Compétences et capacités

  • Comme l’anglais est la principale langue de travail à l’APP, des compétences exceptionnelles en communication orale et écrite en anglais sont requises.
  • Bonnes compétences en communication orale et écrite en français (un atout).
  • Capacité de diriger des réunions et de mener les tâches à terme.
  • Souci du détail, solides compétences en documentation et en tenue de dossiers.
  • Esprit proactif, axé sur la résolution de problèmes et privilégiant le service.
  • Solides compétences en gestion du temps, capacité de fonctionner de façon autonome dans un environnement principalement à distance.
  • Capacité démontrée de travailler en collaboration avec les autres départements et d’exercer une influence sans pouvoir direct.

Conditions d’emploi

  • L’échelle salariale pour ce poste permanent à temps plein est de 97 747$ à 137 711$. Cette échelle reflète le salaire des candidat·es dont les niveaux d’expérience, les connaissances et la qualification professionnelle se rapportant au poste varient. Les offres particulières seront fondées sur les antécédents et la qualification de la personne désignée.
  • Le nombre hebdomadaire d’heures de travail pour ce poste totalise 36,25 h, du lundi au vendredi, de 9 h à 17 h (HP).
  • L’APP offre également aux membres du personnel un ensemble complet d’avantages sociaux collectifs dès leur premier jour de travail.
  • La personne idéale doit avoir le droit de travailler au Canada et pourra travailler à partir de n’importe quel endroit au Canada.  
  • Ce poste exige des déplacements fréquents dans différentes provinces et différents territoires, y compris des voyages périodiques de plusieurs jours avec nuitées.

Si ce poste vous intéresse, veuillez transmettre candidature d’ici la fin de la journée du 30 septembre 2026.

Nous remercions toutes les personnes intéressées; toutefois, nous communiquerons seulement avec celles qui ont été retenues pour les étapes suivantes.

L’APP souscrit au principe de l’équité en matière d’emploi. Conformément à la Loi canadienne sur l’accessibilité de 2019 et à toutes les normes d’accessibilité provinciales et territoriales applicables, l’APP offrira, sur demande, des mesures d’adaptation aux candidat·es en situation de handicap tout au long du processus de recrutement, de sélection ou d’évaluation.

Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

The Retirement Plan Counselor is responsible for delivering on-site and virtual education and enrollment presentations to new and existing defined contribution 401(k)/(a), 403(b), and/or Government 457 plan participants across all plan sizes. The Counselor leverages Empower’s industry leading technology and tools to drive positive results and help employees strive for a successful retirement. This position will also assist the Relationship Management team in effectively establishing and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders within the territory assigned.

What you will do

  • Develop and facilitate communication and education strategies by conducting virtual and on-site group meeting (no one-on-ones) by using various technologies in a professional manner

  • Drive participants to take measurable actions to improve their retirement outcomes including plan enrollment, deferral increases, and rollovers from previous plans

  • Achieve business results and facilitate impactful conversations while meeting service level agreements

  • Consistently complete reporting requirements within required timeframes including logging meetings, attendees and outcomes in appropriate systems

  • Build strong relationships with assigned key contacts, plan sponsor representatives and internal stakeholders to maximize successful participant outcomes

  • Manage meeting schedule, including travel booking

  • Provide feedback to local relationship managers about the effectiveness of communication materials/strategies and assist in identifying alternatives

  • Attend client meetings with other service team members

  • May be asked to participate in finals presentations for new prospects based on the demands of the territory

What you will bring

  • Bachelor's degree and or equivalent experience considered in lieu of a degree

  • 2 – 4 years relevant financial services experience

  • Strong presentation skills required

  • Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams required

  • Strong relationship building and territory management skills

  • FINRA Series 6 and Series 63 registrations within established timelines required

  • FINRA fingerprinting required

What will set you apart

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce preferred

  • Ability to calculate figures such as interest, proportions, percentages, and fractions required

  • Strategic thinker who can work independently

  • Practical experience providing high-level, consultative client interactions preferred

  • Basic knowledge of defined contribution plans preferred

  • Bilingual Spanish preferred, but not required

#PJRPA

***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$59,700.00 - $84,300.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation offered may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age (40 and over), race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

***For remote and hybrid positions you will be required to provide reliable high-speed internet with a wired connection as well as a place in your home to work with limited disruption. You must have reliable connectivity from an internet service provider that is fiber, cable or DSL internet. Other necessary computer equipment, will be provided. You may be required to work in the office if you do not have an adequate home work environment and the required internet connection.***

jobs.excerpt: Regional Sales Manager – North Central U. S. jobs.description:
Regional Sales Manager – North Central U.S. (Remote)
Location: Home-based in CO, IA, KS, MO, MN, ND, NE, SD
Travel Required: Yes, frequent regional and North American travel

About the Role
ConMet is seeking a driven and experienced Regional Sales Manager to join our Aftermarket team. In this key remote-based role, you’ll be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with purchasing, sales, service, and ownership personnel at all Aftermarket Customers, Distributors, Dealers and Fleets. You’ll drive sales growth and profitability across ConMet’s Aftermarket, Trailer Equipment Spec Pull-Through, and Digital Sales channels in your assigned territory.

This home-based role has no direct reports.

We’re looking for a proactive, customer-focused professional who understands the competitive landscape of the commercial vehicle market and can help position ConMet as the supplier of choice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders at customer organizations and within ConMet
  • Achieve annual revenue and profitability targets across multiple product and sales categories
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities by clearly articulating the ConMet value proposition
  • Serve as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams (customer service, engineering, field service, and plant operations)
  • Conduct regular travel throughout the South-Central U.S. and North America to meet customers and attend industry events
  • Monitor and report on market trends and competitor activity
  • Support sales forecasting and new product launches in coordination with the Director of Field Sales
  • Strengthening ConMet’s brand presence through active customer engagement and industry networking

Qualifications

  • Experience in sales within the Class 8 commercial vehicle industry is preferred
  • Previous parts sales experience is a plus
  • Strong technical aptitude and understanding of the commercial vehicle aftermarket preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively across the region and North America
  • Self-starter who thrives in a remote work environment with minimal supervision

ConMet is…

A division of Amsted Industries, has been advancing the commercial vehicle industry since 1964. A leading global provider to original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket channels, ConMet delivers wheel ends, cast metal components, plastic systems, and automated aerodynamic devices. Designed, engineered, tested, and manufactured in-house, ConMet’s comprehensive portfolio is built to enhance vehicle efficiency, performance, and sustainability. Standard on most heavy-duty vehicles in North America, ConMet products are increasingly adopted in global markets.

A Solutions Provider

We’ve been driving the commercial vehicle industry forward with transformative solutions since 1964. In fact, ConMet solutions and products are installed as OEM first-fit equipment on virtually all heavy-duty trucks in North America.

People-First

Collaboration and innovation are at the heart of everything we do. We focus on creating an environment where our people can thrive by improving our workplaces and our communities across all our global locations.

Customer Focused

For decades, ConMet has been a trusted partner to OEMs, fleets, Tier 1 suppliers, and the aftermarket. We supply forward-thinking, high-performance solutions that bring value to our customers.

Committed To Sustainability

Today’s biggest global challenges require transformative change, and we’re committed to doing our part to reduce our carbon footprint and drive environmental sustainability in the commercial vehicle industry.

Note: Employer will not sponsor visas for position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US on a full-time basis.

Compensation & Benefits

  • The full salary range for the position, across all geographies, $100,367 – 172,000 per year. The upper portion of the salary range is typically reserved for existing employees who demonstrate strong performance over time. Starting salary will vary by location, qualifications, and prior experience.
  • Targeted annual bonus is based on company performance against objectives during the fiscal plan year (October 1 – September 30).
  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including medical/dental/vision coverage, life and disability protection.
  • Vacation plan – ConMet offers exempt employees a paid vacation benefit that provides the flexibility to take time off from work based on factors including good discretion, sound performance, and consideration of overall team and business needs.
  • Paid sick leave up to 10 days (80 hours) per calendar year
  • ConMet offers an extremely strong retirement package:
    • ESOP - Participation (100% company paid) in the ConMet/Amsted Employee Stock Ownership Program (ESOP). The Company contributes 10% of considered compensation into this plan each fiscal year.
    • 401k - The Company provides a 401(k) Plan with a 4% employer contribution match.
  • Ten paid holidays per year.
  • Wellness reimbursement.

ConMet provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local laws (“Protected Characteristics”). Ensuring fair wages is an important Company value. Accordingly, the Company will not pay wages to any employee at a rate less than the Company pays to other employees for work that is substantially equivalent and requires comparable skills unless a bona fide factor justifies a pay differential. The Company prohibits pay disparity based on Protected Characteristics or prior salary history. The Company prohibits retaliation against employees for discussing compensation.

Job Title: Full Stack Solutions Developer – Java
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Salary Range: $120,000–$145,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Job Summary:
We are seeking an accomplished Senior Java Full Stack Developer to architect, design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications and distributed systems that operate at significant scale and across multiple business domains. In this role you will be responsible for the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, from translating business requirements into robust technical designs, to writing production-quality code, to deploying cloud-native services and supporting them through their full operational lifespan. The successful candidate will bring deep backend expertise in Java and the Spring ecosystem, combined with strong hands-on experience building responsive, component-driven front-end applications using modern JavaScript frameworks. You will work closely with product managers, architects, DevOps engineers, and fellow developers in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality, secure, and performant applications that directly support strategic business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong, demonstrable understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and end-to-end system design principles.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Java (versions 11 and 17), the Spring Boot framework, and the design of clean, idiomatic RESTful APIs.
  • Hands-on, production-level experience designing and operating microservices architectures, including service decomposition, inter-service communication, and observability patterns.
  • Proven experience developing front-end applications using React, with working familiarity in Angular or Vue considered a strong plus.
  • Strong SQL skills and meaningful experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server, including query tuning and schema design.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD tooling and Git-based version control workflows, including branching strategies, code review practices, and release management.
  • Hands-on experience deploying applications to at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including familiarity with managed services, networking, and identity primitives.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills, with the discipline to investigate problems methodically and document findings clearly.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience designing and operating event-driven architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent streaming platforms.
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes in production environments.
  • Exposure to distributed system design principles such as eventual consistency, CAP trade-offs, idempotency, and saga patterns.
  • Experience writing automation tests using modern frameworks and contributing to test-driven and behavior-driven development practices.

jobs.excerpt: Nursing Examination Subject Matter ExpertRasmussen UniversityThe School of Nursing seeks a highly qualified nursing education professional to support examination development, implementation, and continuous quality improvement across nursing programs.
jobs.description:
Nursing Examination Subject Matter Expert

Rasmussen University

The School of Nursing seeks a highly qualified nursing education professional to support examination development, implementation, and continuous quality improvement across nursing programs. This position will partner closely with Program Directors, curriculum leaders, and faculty to facilitate the development of high-quality assessments that align with NCLEX®, the NCSBN Clinical Judgment Measurement Model (CJMM), program outcomes, and best practices in nursing education assessment.

The Nursing Exam SME will provide subject matter expertise in test item writing, exam assembly, exam delivery processes, psychometric review, and item analysis. This role will support the ongoing enhancement of assessment practices across the School of Nursing and contribute to faculty development related to examination quality and student success.

This is a part-time remote, temporary/contract role expected to run approximately six months.

Responsibilities

Examination Development

  • Lead the development and review of nursing examination items across nursing courses and exam blueprints.
  • Ensure exam items align with course outcomes, program outcomes, NCLEX test plan expectations, CJMM principles, and exam blueprints.
  • Collaborate with Program Directors and faculty to create and revise exam blueprints.
  • Review assessments for content validity, fairness, clarity, and appropriate cognitive level.
  • Support exam construction and balancing of content areas and cognitive complexity.

Faculty Consultation and Development

  • Coach Program Directors and faculty on evidence-based exam development practices.
  • Provide guidance on:
    • Best practices for test item writing
    • Determination of Bloom's cognitive levels
    • Classification of CJMM cognitive processes
    • Construction of Next Generation NCLEX-style items
    • Assessment alignment with learning outcomes
  • Develop faculty resources, workshops, and reference materials related to nursing assessment.

Exam Delivery and Operations

  • Support the implementation and administration of nursing examinations.
  • Collaborate with academic leadership to identify and resolve assessment-related concerns.
  • Assist with exam security, version control, and quality assurance processes.
  • Participate in assessment workflow design and continuous process improvement initiatives.

Exam Analysis and Quality Improvement

  • Conduct post-exam psychometric reviews and item analyses.
  • Partner with Program Directors to evaluate examination performance data.
  • Interpret key assessment metrics, including:
    • Item difficulty
    • Item discrimination
    • Distractor effectiveness
    • Reliability measures
  • Provide recommendations for item revision, retention, or retirement.
  • Monitor assessment quality trends and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Assessment Leadership

  • Serve as a resource for nursing assessment best practices.
  • Promote consistency in examination standards across nursing programs.
  • Support ongoing curriculum redesign and assessment initiatives.
  • Assist in establishing and maintaining assessment quality benchmarks.

Requirements

  • Master's degree in Nursing (MSN) from an accredited institution
  • Current RN license that has never been encumbered
  • Minimum of three years of experience in nursing education
  • Demonstrated experience in nursing exam development and assessment design
  • Strong understanding of NCLEX-RN test plans and contemporary nursing education assessment strategies
  • Experience analyzing exam performance data and item analysis reports
  • Knowledge of learning outcomes assessment and curriculum alignment principles
  • Certified Nurse Educator (CNE) credential preferred
  • Continuous quality improvement processes for nursing assessments.

About Us:

American Public University System (the System) is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission (HLC) (www.hlcommission.org), an institutional accreditation agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. HLC accredits degree-granting institutions nationwide and is also recognized by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation. The System is comprised of American Military University, American Public University, Rasmussen University, and Hondros College of Nursing. The System is authorized by the West Virginia Higher Education Policy Commission and other appropriate agencies in the states where it has campuses. The System is authorized to operate as a postsecondary educational institution by the Illinois Board of Higher Education. American Public University System, Inc., which operates the System, is a wholly owned subsidiary of American Public Education, Inc. American Public University System, American Public University, and American Military University are not affiliated with American University or the U.S. Military.

It is the policy of Rasmussen University to afford equal opportunity to all qualified persons. We treat all qualified individuals equally as to their recruitment, hiring, assignments, advancements, compensation, and all other terms and conditions of employment. Rasmussen University does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, or physical, mental, or sensory disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: Req ID:389163 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us.
jobs.description:
Req ID:389163

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Senior IT Project Manager - Oracle EBS Upgrade - REMOTE to join our team in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania (US-PA), United States (US).

We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Project Manager to lead a complex, enterprise-scale Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) upgrade from initial planning through production deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.

The ideal candidate will have 10+ years of IT project/program management experience, including hands-on leadership of at least two full-lifecycle Oracle EBS upgrades or major Oracle EBS transformation initiatives.

This role will be responsible for managing the overall scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, dependencies, governance, vendors, testing, cutover, and stakeholder communications. The Project Manager will coordinate across business, functional, application, technical, database, infrastructure, integration, security, testing, and third-party teams to ensure successful delivery.

The successful candidate should be comfortable working with senior business leaders, IT leadership, Oracle/support organizations, system integrators, implementation partners, contractors, and third-party vendors in a complex enterprise environment.

Day to Day Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end Oracle EBS upgrade lifecycle, including planning, assessment, design, build, remediation, testing, deployment, hypercare, stabilization, and project closure.
  • Develop and maintain the overall upgrade strategy, roadmap, delivery milestones, and integrated project schedule.
  • Coordinate activities across Oracle EBS applications, databases, infrastructure, integrations, security, customizations, environments, and third-party applications.
  • Ensure application, technical, infrastructure, and business workstreams remain aligned throughout the upgrade.
  • Manage upgrade dependencies, compatibility considerations, customization remediation, integration readiness, and environment planning.

Project Planning & Delivery Management

  • Develop and manage the Integrated Project Plan, including milestones, critical path, dependencies, resources, budgets, and delivery schedules.
  • Manage multiple concurrent workstreams across business and technology organizations.
  • Track project progress against scope, schedule, budget, quality, and resource commitments.
  • Identify schedule conflicts, resource constraints, and cross-workstream dependencies and drive them to resolution.
  • Ensure project deliverables, documentation, approvals, and stage-gate requirements are completed according to agreed timelines.

Governance, RAID & Change Control

  • Establish and manage effective project governance and operating cadence.
  • Maintain comprehensive RAID logs covering Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies.
  • Drive risk identification, mitigation planning, issue resolution, and appropriate escalation.
  • Establish and manage project change-control processes, including assessment of scope, schedule, resource, and financial impacts.
  • Facilitate project governance meetings, leadership reviews, and decision-making forums.
  • Provide clear and concise project health reporting, milestone tracking, and executive dashboards.

Testing Governance

  • Lead overall testing governance across:
    • System Integration Testing (SIT)
    • Regression Testing
    • User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
    • Performance Testing
    • Security Testing
  • Coordinate testing schedules, environment readiness, business participation, and entry/exit criteria.
  • Oversee defect management, prioritization, resolution, and escalation.
  • Ensure critical business processes, integrations, customizations, and interfaces are appropriately validated before production deployment.
  • Drive business and operational readiness for go-live.

Cutover & Go-Live Management

  • Develop and manage the comprehensive cutover strategy and detailed cutover plan.
  • Coordinate and lead mock cutovers / dress rehearsals to validate deployment procedures and timing.
  • Establish production readiness and go/no-go criteria.
  • Lead production deployment and command-center activities across all participating teams.
  • Coordinate business, application, infrastructure, integration, security, database, and vendor teams during cutover.
  • Manage post-production hypercare and stabilization, ensuring issues are prioritized and resolved effectively.
  • Facilitate transition to steady-state production support and formal project closure.

Stakeholder & Executive Management

  • Serve as the primary project management interface across business and IT stakeholders.
  • Facilitate executive steering committee meetings, project governance reviews, and cross-functional workstream meetings.
  • Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, financials, and milestones clearly to senior leadership.
  • Drive timely decision-making and escalate critical issues when necessary.
  • Build alignment among business stakeholders, technology teams, and external delivery partners.

Vendor & Partner Management

  • Coordinate internal teams, contractors, Oracle resources, implementation partners, consulting organizations, system integrators, and third-party vendors.
  • Establish clear ownership and accountability for vendor deliverables.
  • Track partner commitments, dependencies, deliverable quality, and schedule performance.
  • Facilitate resolution of cross-vendor and cross-team dependencies.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Manage project budgets, forecasts, financial performance, and resource capacity.
  • Monitor actuals against forecasts and identify financial or resource risks.
  • Manage project staffing requirements and capacity across multiple workstreams.
  • Maintain project metrics, documentation, dashboards, and executive-level reporting.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of IT Project / Program Management experience, including large-scale enterprise application implementations, upgrades, or transformation programs.
  • 5 to 7 years of hands-on project management experience leading at least two full-lifecycle Oracle EBS upgrades or major Oracle EBS transformation initiatives.
  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience managing mid- to high-complexity ERP/application upgrade programs involving multiple business functions, integrations, technical dependencies, and workstreams.
  • 5+ years of strong understanding of Oracle EBS architecture, modules, integrations, customizations, environments, and upgrade dependencies.
  • 5+ years of experience managing Oracle EBS upgrade activities including:
    • Impact assessments
    • Customization remediation
    • Integration testing
    • Regression testing
    • UAT
    • Performance testing
    • Cutover
    • Production deployment
    • Hypercare and stabilization

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing Oracle EBS Release 12.2.x upgrades.
  • Strong familiarity with Oracle EBS functional areas, integrations, customizations, and supporting Oracle technologies.
  • Experience delivering ERP/application programs within regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting global or multi-business-unit deployments.
  • Experience working with geographically distributed business and technology teams.
  • PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe, Scrum, or similar project/program management certification.
  • Experience with Thermo Fisher Project Governance is highly desirable.
  • Strong experience managing large cross-functional and multi-workstream teams.
  • Proven experience developing and managing:
    • Integrated project plans
    • RAID logs
    • Dependency management
    • Change control
    • Testing governance
    • Cutover plans
    • Executive reporting
  • Experience managing implementation partners, consulting organizations, system integrators, and third-party vendors.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, risk management, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Working knowledge of SDLC, release management, testing methodologies, and IT change-control processes.
  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, or equivalent.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for U.S.-based positions. The starting pay range for this role is $87,952 – 162,875. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.

This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation based on individual and/or company performance.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

Embedded AI Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Embedded AI Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are looking for an Embedded AI Engineer to design, optimize, and deploy machine learning models that run efficiently on resource-constrained edge devices, including mobile platforms, embedded systems, and specialized accelerators. The role requires deep expertise in model compression, quantization, and hardware-aware optimization, along with strong systems engineering skills to ship reliable AI capabilities outside the data center. The ideal candidate has shipped edge AI in production environments where compute, memory, energy, and connectivity constraints fundamentally shape the engineering trade-offs.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement edge AI solutions optimized for diverse hardware including mobile SoCs, NPUs, and embedded accelerators.
  • Apply quantization, pruning, distillation, and architectural optimization to fit models within edge constraints.
  • Tune model performance for latency, energy efficiency, and memory footprint on target hardware.
  • Build cross-platform inference runtimes leveraging frameworks such as TensorFlow Lite, ONNX Runtime, and Core ML.
  • Optimize models for specific accelerator backends including DSPs, NPUs, and mobile GPUs.
  • Implement on-device model update, versioning, and rollback workflows that allow safe staged rollouts to large device populations and rapid recovery if a model release behaves unexpectedly in the field.
  • Design hybrid edge-cloud architectures that gracefully degrade based on connectivity and device capability.
  • Build telemetry pipelines that respect privacy while enabling continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and product teams to align AI capabilities with device constraints.
  • Implement secure execution paths, model protection, and integrity verification on edge devices.
  • Develop benchmarking suites that characterize accuracy, latency, and energy trade-offs across devices.
  • Drive responsible AI considerations including on-device privacy and bias evaluation.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Stay current with edge AI hardware and software developments, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in ML engineering, with significant work on edge or mobile AI.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and C++.
  • Hands-on experience with model compression, quantization, and pruning techniques.
  • Experience with at least one major edge inference framework.
  • Solid understanding of mobile and embedded hardware architectures.
  • Experience deploying ML models to production on mobile or embedded platforms.
  • Strong performance engineering and profiling skills.
  • Familiarity with on-device privacy and security considerations.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with custom NPU or DSP toolchains.
  • Familiarity with federated learning or on-device personalization.
  • Exposure to safety-critical or industrial edge deployments.
  • Open-source contributions to edge AI frameworks.
  • Experience optimizing LLMs for on-device inference.

jobs.title: Senior Packaging Production Designer
jobs.excerpt: At Thorne, we work to deliver high-quality, science-backed solutions to empower individuals to take a proactive approach to their well-being.
jobs.description:
At Thorne, we work to deliver high-quality, science-backed solutions to empower individuals to take a proactive approach to their well-being. Each day begins with a mission to help others discover and achieve their best health. We count on our team members to challenge and push the boundaries to make that happen. At Thorne, you’ll be joining a team of more than 750 passionate individuals committed to our cause of providing superior health solutions at every age and life stage.

The Senior Production Packaging Designer is responsible for leading the mechanical development, production readiness, and ongoing maintenance of packaging and labeling artwork across the organization’s global product portfolio. This role serves as the primary production artwork owner, ensuring packaging moves accurately and efficiently from approved creative through cross-functional review, final production files, printer proofs, and release.

Working closely with Creative, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, Legal, PDG, and external production partners, this individual will translate approved design direction into accurate, compliant, and production-ready packaging while maintaining consistency across SKUs, formats, vendors, and production runs.

This role provides a single point of ownership for packaging production and helps establish the standards, processes, and governance needed to manage ongoing packaging needs - including new product launches, product updates, regulatory and formulation changes, certifications, renames, new formats, and other business-driven revisions.
The ideal candidate combines exceptional production design expertise with strong operational ownership, attention to detail, and a systems-oriented mindset. They are equally comfortable executing packaging artwork, navigating complex approval workflows, partnering with printers and vendors, and building processes that improve consistency and efficiency across the portfolio.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Day-to-Day Packaging Ownership
  • Serve as the day-to-day owner of packaging production artwork across the product portfolio, managing work from approved creative through mechanical development, review, approval, prepress, proofing, and final release.
  • Translate approved creative concepts into accurate, production-ready mechanical artwork across multiple packaging formats, sizes, product variants, markets, and print processes.
  • Build and maintain packaging artwork using approved dielines and specifications, including regulatory copy, ingredient and nutrition information, claims, certifications, barcodes, symbols, legal language, trademarks, and print specifications.
  • Own ongoing packaging revisions resulting from product launches, regulatory changes, formulation or ingredient updates, claims, certifications, renames, legal requirements, manufacturing changes, and other approved business needs.
  • Evaluate the impact of packaging changes across related SKUs, formats, and markets and ensure updates are implemented consistently across all affected files.
Packaging Quality, Compliance & Production
  • Partner with Quality, Regulatory, Medical, and the Product Team to ensure approved packaging and labeling requirements are accurately reflected in final production artwork.
  • Perform comprehensive quality-control reviews before artwork is routed, approved, or released, identifying inconsistencies, errors, and production risks before manufacturing.
  • Collaborate directly with printers, converters, prepress vendors, packaging suppliers, Engineering, and Operations to ensure artwork meets technical and manufacturing specifications.
  • Review and approve digital proofs, contract proofs, press proofs, and color targets; partner with printers during press approvals when required.
  • Ensure color, print quality, typography, imagery, and other design details are executed consistently across vendors, substrates, packaging formats, and production runs.
  • Identify and resolve artwork, dieline, prepress, print, and production issues before manufacturing while protecting the integrity of approved creative.
  • Select and specify appropriate label sizes based on bottle/container dimensions, packaging requirements, and production specifications, partnering with Engineering and Operations as needed.
Packaging Systems, Standards & Governance
  • Establish and maintain disciplined standards for file naming, version control, artwork archiving, production-file organization, and artwork history to ensure traceability and clear identification of current approved artwork.
  • Own packaging artwork through established Change Management and project-management systems, including ETQ and Wrike, ensuring work is properly routed, documented, approved, and released.
  • Partner with the cross-functional teams to continuously improve the end-to-end packaging workflow and clarify ownership, handoffs, approvals, and quality-control checkpoints.
  • Develop and maintain production standards, templates, mechanical requirements, proofing protocols, file structures, and documentation that support a consistent and scalable packaging program.
  • Serve as the organization's subject-matter expert for packaging production artwork, providing guidance to internal teams on mechanical development, prepress, print, and production requirements.
  • Support larger packaging initiatives, portfolio updates, and brand evolution as needed while maintaining ownership of ongoing business-as-usual packaging needs
Cross-Functional Partnership & Prioritization
  • Act as a central packaging production partner across Creative, Quality, Regulatory, Legal, Operations, Engineering, Project Management, Product Marketing, and external vendors.
  • Manage multiple concurrent packaging projects and shifting priorities while maintaining accuracy, timelines, and clear communication with stakeholders.
  • Raise packaging risks, issues, and dependencies early and recommend practical solutions that keep work moving without compromising quality or compliance.
  • Maintain current knowledge of packaging production technologies, print processes, artwork-management practices, and industry best practices.

WHAT YOU NEED

  • 15+ years of professional experience in packaging production, mechanical artwork, production design, studio production, or a related discipline, preferably supporting a large consumer product portfolio.
  • Demonstrated experience working within a regulated CPG environment with complex packaging development, review, and approval processes; food, beverage, nutrition, supplements, wellness, OTC, or similarly regulated categories strongly preferred.
  • Supplement and nutritional product experience highly preferred, including familiarity with regulated labels, claims, ingredient information, and Supplement Facts panels.
  • Demonstrated experience managing production artwork across high-volume portfolios with multiple SKUs, packaging formats, variants, and/or international markets.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, Acrobat, and Photoshop, with mastery of production artwork and prepress practices.
  • Advanced knowledge of packaging mechanical development, including dielines, typography, image resolution, bleeds, trapping, separations, spot colors, print specifications, UPC barcodes, and production file preparation.
  • Strong working knowledge of major packaging print and production processes and experience partnering directly with printers, converters, prepress houses, packaging suppliers, and production agencies.
  • Experience operating within formal regulatory, legal, and quality review and approval environments and with workflow systems such as ETQ, Wrike, Workfront, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of artwork-management practices, including version control, asset management, proofing, approval workflows, file release, and archival requirements.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and judgment, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and determine when artwork is ready to advance to review or production.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate requirements among creative, regulatory, quality, technical, operational, and external production stakeholders.
  • Systems-oriented mindset with the ability to balance immediate production execution with development of scalable, long-term packaging processes

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation
  • 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for employees
  • Company-paid short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Company- paid life insurance
  • 401k plan with employer matching contributions up to 4%
  • Gym membership reimbursement
  • Monthly allowance of Thorne supplements
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off and holiday leave
  • Training, professional development, and career growth opportunities

jobs.description:
About Bask & Lather Co.

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing, scalp-first textured haircare company serving customers across direct-to-consumer, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and major retail channels. We are a lean, entrepreneurial organization that moves quickly, operates with high ownership, and expects team members to turn priorities into action without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

Role Overview

The Controller will own the accounting function end-to-end and serve as the backbone of financial integrity, reporting, and operational discipline. This role will partner closely with the Head of Finance to build scalable processes and support retail expansion.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring both execution and system-building.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Close and Reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.
  • Establish a path to preliminary financial reporting within five business days and a complete, supportable close within ten business days.
  • Prepare accurate, timely, and GAAP-compliant financial statements.
  • Own balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals, reserves, account substantiation, and financial-statement support.
  • Maintain complete, organized, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Develop and maintain the accounting calendar, close checklist, and departmental deadlines.
  • Coordinate external audit and tax requirements.
  • Identify accounting issues proactively and present clear recommendations to the Head of Finance.

2. Inventory, COGS, and Gross-Margin Integrity

  • Own inventory accounting across manufacturers, 3PLs, marketplaces, retail channels, and DTC operations.
  • Reconcile inventory monthly among the general ledger, NetSuite, 3PL records, retailer activity, and internal inventory schedules.
  • Establish reliable standard costs, landed costs, manufacturing variances, and SKU-level COGS.
  • Own accounting for inventory in transit, shrinkage, obsolescence, damaged inventory, reserves, and write-offs.
  • Partner with Supply Chain on purchase-order receipts, freight accruals, vendor reconciliations, and cycle-count controls.
  • Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies promptly.
  • Improve gross-margin visibility by SKU, product category, channel, and customer.
  • Ensure inventory accounting policies and valuation methodologies are consistently documented and applied.

3. Revenue and Channel Accounting

  • Own revenue accounting and settlement reconciliation across Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Walmart, wholesale, and other marketplace and retail channels.
  • Ensure appropriate revenue recognition, cutoff, and channel-level reporting.
  • Reconcile platform settlements, transaction fees, refunds, returns, reserves, receivables, and cash receipts.
  • Own accounting for retailer deductions, chargebacks, promotions, markdowns, allowances, and trade spend.
  • Ensure accurate gross-to-net and contra-revenue treatment.
  • Build controls to identify missing payments, invalid deductions, unreimbursed claims, and settlement discrepancies.
  • Partner with Commercialization, E-Commerce, Customer Experience, and Supply Chain to resolve channel and retailer discrepancies.
  • Maintain reliable supporting schedules for retail receivables, marketplace settlements, returns, and deductions.

4. Cash, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and Working Capital

  • Oversee the accounts receivable and accounts payable functions, including management and development of the existing AP/AR Specialist.
  • Maintain accurate daily and weekly cash reporting.
  • Support short- and long-term cash-flow forecasting.
  • Strengthen collections discipline and retailer receivables management.
  • Improve vendor-payment controls, approval workflows, and payment timing.
  • Partner with the Head of Finance and Supply Chain to improve the cash conversion cycle.
  • Monitor aged receivables, vendor liabilities, accruals, and working-capital risks.
  • Maintain appropriate segregation of duties and payment authorization controls.

5. NetSuite and Financial Systems

  • Partner with the Head of Finance to implement, optimize, and maintain NetSuite.
  • Help establish a scalable chart of accounts, entity structure, close process, and financial-reporting architecture.
  • Improve integration and reconciliation among NetSuite, Shopify, marketplaces, banks, 3PLs, and financial-reporting tools.
  • Establish reliable data flows for revenue, inventory, COGS, receivables, payables, and cash.
  • Lead accounting-data validation, system testing, process documentation, and user adoption.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual accounting processes while maintaining appropriate controls.
  • Ensure system configurations and accounting workflows support accurate and timely reporting.

6. Internal Controls, Compliance, and Accounting Policies

  • Establish internal controls appropriate for a rapidly scaling, multichannel consumer-products company.
  • Create and maintain accounting policies, standard operating procedures, approval matrices, and financial-control documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local tax requirements, including sales-tax and multi-state nexus obligations.
  • Coordinate with external tax, audit, and regulatory advisors.
  • Strengthen controls around cash, inventory, revenue, purchasing, vendor payments, retailer deductions, and financial close.
  • Maintain an accounting environment that is consistently audit-ready.
  • Monitor compliance with accounting policies and remediate control deficiencies.

7. Team Leadership

  • Manage, develop, and hold the accounting team accountable for accuracy, timeliness, and execution.
  • Establish clear responsibilities, deadlines, review standards, and escalation protocols.
  • Evaluate the future accounting-team structure and recommend additional resources as the company scales.
  • Create a high-performance culture grounded in ownership, integrity, urgency, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a strong cross-functional partner to Finance, Supply Chain, Commercialization, E-Commerce, Customer Experience, and Operations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.
  • CPA strongly preferred.
  • 8-12+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Controller or Assistant Controller-level responsibility.
  • Experience owning a complete monthly close and preparing GAAP-compliant financial statements.
  • Deep experience with inventory, cost accounting, landed costs, COGS, gross margin, and inventory reconciliations.
  • Experience with direct-to-consumer retail, wholesale, marketplace and multichannel revenue accounting.
  • Experience in CPG, beauty, consumer products, retail, or another inventory-intensive business is a must..
  • NetSuite implementation, optimization, or administration experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting external audits preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of internal controls, revenue recognition, gross-to-net accounting, and working-capital management.
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong financial-systems judgment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing accounting professionals.

Profile

  • Hands-on operator who can both execute and build
  • Detail-obsessed with strong ownership mentality
  • Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
  • Strong cross-functional partner (Supply Chain, Marketing, Sales, Ops)
  • High integrity and low ego

Why This Role

  • Opportunity to build the accounting foundation of a breakout brand
  • Direct exposure to executive team and strategic decisions

The role focuses on the systems engineering side of AI deployment, including request routing, batching, caching, autoscaling, GPU utilization, and end-to-end observability across diverse model workloads.   • Operate incident response for high-availability AI services and drive durable reliability improvements.
  • Collaborate with ML and product teams to support new model releases and capability rollouts.

  • Stay current with AI serving research and translate advances into production capabilities.

We’re building a new kind of engineering function at Gametime — one that sits within our CX teams, not beside them. As our first AI Engineer on the Ops team, you’ll be embedded directly within Fan Ops and Marketplace Ops as an AI Accelerator — working side-by-side with our customer experience and marketplace specialists to make AI the default mode for how the team operates. Not an occasional tool. The foundation of how every operator at Gametime executes. Today, our ops teams are already resourceful and fast. Your job is to multiply what they can do. You’ll design and build production-grade agentic workflows that automate the repetitive, the analytical, and the operationally complex — from fan issue triage to seller risk monitoring to marketplace optimization workflows. You’ll teach non-technical teammates how to work with AI tools and build their own automations. And you’ll help establish the playbook for embedding AI capability across the entire Operations org. This is a hands-on, move-fast, build-first role. Your measure of success is the number of workflows you’ve permanently transformed and the degree to which operators in your cohort reach for an AI tool before anything else.   • Identify and document the highest-leverage workflow transformations across Fan Ops and Marketplace Ops by deeply understanding how your stakeholders work and what slows them down

  • Teach and coach operations teammates on how to work with AI tools, build automations, and think in workflows
  • Own the full lifecycle of what you build — from design through production deployment, monitoring, and iteration to impact
  • Explore and evaluate new agentic frameworks, LLM capabilities, and AI tooling as the space evolves rapidly
  • Help define the model for AI-embedded engineering across Gametime’s broader Operations org

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 4+ years of technical operations or software engineering experience, with at least 1 year building production LLM or agentic systems
  • Experience building and deploying tools that non-engineers use in production — not just internal dev tooling
  • Ability to work closely with non-technical stakeholders, translate their domain knowledge into technical requirements, and communicate what you’ve built in plain language
  • Demonstrated experience coaching or enabling others — formally or informally — with evidence that people you’ve helped actually changed how they work

In 90 days, you’ve shipped production agents that Fan Ops and Marketplace Ops teams use weekly without your involvement. Our bank client is seeking to fill a Remote 1099/Contract Credit Analyst role. **PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH**

Location: Remote – Latin America

Industry: Construction / General Contracting
Compensation:$1,600–$1,900 USD/month
Schedule: Full-Time | Availability to work during U.S. business hours
English Proficiency: Professional written and spoken English required

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based construction company specializing in the development of community parks, amenity centers, recreational spaces, monuments, and other outdoor environments for residential developers and communities.

The company works closely with project managers, construction managers, landscape architects, and other industry partners to deliver high-quality projects with a strong focus on execution, cost control, and operational excellence.

As the organization continues to manage a growing portfolio of active construction projects, it is strengthening its financial and project accounting capabilities to provide greater visibility into project performance and costs.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Job Cost Accountant to own the accuracy and integrity of job cost data across an active portfolio of construction projects.

This role is dedicated to project financial performance and will be responsible for running and reviewing job cost reports, maintaining accurate cost coding, reconciling project financial data between Sage 100 and Procore, managing the monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule, and partnering directly with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

This is not a passive reporting role. The Job Cost Accountant will be embedded with project teams and serve as a financial partner to operations, helping ensure that costs are accurately captured, forecasts remain current, and project leadership has reliable financial information for decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Job Cost Reporting & Accuracy

  • Run, review, and distribute weekly and monthly job cost reports from Sage 100 for all active projects.

  • Reconcile Procore commitments, change orders, and invoicing against Sage 100 job cost detail.

  • Identify financial variances and work with project teams to resolve discrepancies at the source.

  • Review cost coding for AP invoices, subcontractor billings, labor, and equipment charges before they close to the job.

  • Identify misallocated expenses and coordinate corrections with the appropriate project stakeholders.

  • Maintain an accurate cost code structure in collaboration with finance and project leadership.

  • Ensure job cost information rolls up accurately for financial reporting, project analysis, and estimating feedback.

Project Management & Construction Management Partnership

  • Conduct formal monthly job cost reviews with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

  • Review budget vs. actual costs, committed costs, job cost detail, and forecast-to-complete estimates.

  • Partner with project teams to identify and correct misallocated expenses.

  • Serve as a primary finance resource for questions related to job costs, cost code selection, and committed cost reconciliation.

  • Escalate recurring coding or accountability issues to finance and project leadership when appropriate.

WIP & Percentage of Completion

  • Own the monthly WIP schedule across all active projects.

  • Maintain accurate calculations for:

    • Cost to date

    • Estimated cost at completion

    • Percentage complete

    • Earned revenue

    • Over/under billings

  • Partner with Project Managers to validate monthly cost-to-complete estimates.

  • Identify and challenge outdated or unsupported project forecasts.

  • Deliver a clean, accurate, and defensible WIP package as part of the monthly financial close process.

Specialized Cost Tracking

  • Partner with project leadership to capture the true cost of specialized construction activities when deeper cost analysis is required.

  • Establish tracking approaches before activities begin, including appropriate cost codes, labor tracking, equipment capture, and reporting structure.

  • Ensure cost information is collected accurately in real time rather than reconstructed after project activities are completed.

  • Prepare actual-cost reporting that can support future estimating, purchasing, project planning, and strategic decision-making.

Systems, Reporting & Documentation

  • Work extensively in Sage 100 and Procore as the primary systems for project cost accounting.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent financial data across both systems.

  • Build and maintain Excel reporting workbooks summarizing job cost, WIP, committed cost, and project financial performance.

  • Use AI-enabled tools and services, where appropriate, to improve reporting, reconciliation, and document review processes.

  • Maintain organized documentation and strong data hygiene across project accounting workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of job cost accounting experience with a general contractor, specialty contractor, or construction company.

  • Construction industry accounting experience is required.
