Title: Program Manager, Forecast Science & Policy

Location: India - remote preferred; open to strong candidates based elsewhere, including the US and Europe

Position: Full-time

Posted on: September 15, 2026

Application deadline: October 6, 2026, 6 pm IST

Summary

Precision Development (PxD) is hiring a Program Manager, Forecast Science & Policy for its weather forecast initiative.

Candidates who studied physics, statistics, applied math, or engineering and moved toward international development or behavioral/development economics are especially well suited to this role. While the position does not involve building forecast models directly, it requires a genuine understanding of ensemble modeling, forecast skill metrics, and model uncertainty, sufficient to engage substantively with atmospheric scientists and translate that understanding into language that informs program and policy decisions with government partners. This is an opportunity to apply strong technical training to real-world problems at scale, working at the intersection of meteorology, program delivery, and public policy.

Precision Development (PxD) is seeking a Program Manager, Forecast Science & Policy to serve as a critical technical translator within its weather forecasting initiative. The successful candidate will sit at the intersection of meteorology / atmospheric science and program delivery — developing a deep enough understanding of the technical details behind PxD's forecasting partners' work (what can and cannot be delivered, and why) to communicate this clearly and accurately to both internal teams and external stakeholders, including government partners.

This is not a data science role, nor is it a traditional government-partnerships role. It requires someone who has foundational knowledge of statistics and can genuinely understand the technical substance of what forecasting partners are saying model capabilities, limitations, and tradeoffs and translate that into language that internal teams and external stakeholders can act on with confidence.

This role builds on PxD's demonstrated success in pioneering digital advisory services. In 2025, PxD worked with partners to disseminate AI-generated monsoon forecasts to 39+ million farmers across 13 states. In 2026, this has scaled to 52+ million farmers. The Technical Project Manager will play a key role in ensuring that the technical realities of this forecasting work are clearly understood and communicated across the initiative, so that decisions — internal and external — are grounded in an accurate picture of what the science can and cannot yet do.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Translation. Develop a working technical understanding of PxD's forecasting partners' methods, capabilities, and limitations (e.g., model uncertainty, forecast skill, data constraints), sufficient to explain, in plain language, why something can or cannot currently be delivered.

Internal & External Communication. Synthesize and translate complex scientific findings — including forecast models, agronomic research, and MEL data — into clear, accessible materials for internal stakeholders, policymakers, practitioners, and general audiences. Prepare reports, presentations, and policy briefs as needed.

Cross-Team Coordination. Support structured, ongoing communication between PxD's technical/scientific partners and internal teams and government stakeholders, ensuring that technical constraints and possibilities are accurately reflected in program and policy conversations.

Qualifications

  • At least 4 - 6 years of relevant work experience
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field such as physics, mathematics/statistics, computational science, engineering, and/or economics with a quantitative focus; candidates with non-traditional backgrounds who combine strong quantitative training with experience in technical or scientific environments are encouraged to apply
  • Strong foundational knowledge in quantitative and computational methods, with the ability to engage critically and constructively with forecast modeling scientists; familiarity with key concepts such as ensemble modeling, probabilistic forecasting, forecast skill metrics, and model uncertainties, whether from formal training or applied experience, is a plus
  • Proficiency in Python or R required; experience with data pipelines, cloud-based workflows, or geospatial data tools (e.g., xarray, netCDF, GIS) is strongly preferred
  • Experience working with or interpreting outputs from AI/ML-based models, and translating technical products into decision-relevant information for non-specialist audiences, is strongly preferred
  • Strong ability to synthesize and communicate complex technical or scientific information for non-specialist audiences, including translating probabilistic or uncertain findings (e.g., forecast confidence intervals, model limitations) into language that supports rather than undermines confidence in decision-making
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English; fluency in Hindi is preferred; proficiency in other languages is a plus
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail; ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
  • Familiarity with climate adaptation, digital agriculture, and experimental economics is strongly desired
  • Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects simultaneously
  • Passion for impact and a strong sense of purpose aligned with PxD's mission to serve smallholder farmers. A collaborative attitude, resilience in the face of challenges, and a drive to continuously learn and innovate
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed

About PxD

PxD is a rapidly scaling global non-profit that harnesses the power of technology, data science, and behavioral economics to provide targeted information to farmers in low and middle income countries. Providing the right information to the right people, in the right way and at the right time, increases incomes, protects the environment, and improves well-being. We are evidence-based: we test our interventions with randomized controlled trials to prove our impact and cost effectiveness, to simultaneously learn from and improve our service, and to demonstrate our value to funders and partners. There are few programmes in international development that are as demonstrably cost effective as ours.

How to Apply

To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. The position will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the application deadline of October 6, 2026, 5 pm IST.

PxD is committed to building an inclusive and diverse organization. We do not make decisions based on gender, gender identity, class, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or any other personal characteristics that are unrelated to the role. We accommodate flexible working to make sure you are as productive and happy as you can be.

We will use any personal data you provide for recruitment purposes only.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Product Strategy & Operations
jobs.excerpt: Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities.
jobs.description:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

Start Date: 11/2/2026

Role Scope

Habitat Health’s Product team is focused on using AI, technology, and disciplined workflow design to turn how the company works into scalable, measurable capability. We’re looking for a smart, driven person to help the team do more — someone who takes ambiguous problems off our plate and turns them into shipped, adopted, measurable results.

This is a broad role, and deliberately so. In a given week you might map how an operational process actually works today, build a scrappy automation that saves the team hours, sit in a center watching the real workflow, pull data to settle a debate, and then own the rollout that makes a new tool actually stick. We care far more about horsepower, curiosity, and ownership than about a specific background — if you’re the kind of person who sees a manual, repetitive process and can’t help but fix it, you’ll fit here.

You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data and functional owners across clinical, operational, enrollment, and other enterprise teams. This is a high-trust, high-exposure seat close to how the company runs.

What You’ll Do

Turning ambiguity into working systems

  • Jump into whatever the product team needs most — research, analysis, process mapping, AI deployment, docs, coordination, a quick prototype — and bring structure to fast-moving, multi-stakeholder work.
  • Break big fuzzy asks from stakeholders into clear, actionable plans, and keep the relevant people aligned as things move.
  • Hunt down manual, repetitive, or error-prone processes and eliminate them — with off-the-shelf tools, no-code builders, light scripting, AI, or a clean spec handed to engineering.
  • Use AI productivity tools (Claude, ChatGPT, and the like) as a daily default to accelerate drafting, analysis, and operational workflows.
  • Work with the Product, Technical, and functional leads to build systems and reporting — templates, dashboards, checklists, simple integrations — that makes good work repeatable.

Get results on the ground

  • Travel to Habitat centers to see how the work really happens, build trust with front-line teams, and become the face of the tools and workflows we roll out.
  • Support adoption end to end: onboarding, training, follow-through, and iteration until something is actually used, not just launched.
  • Chase measurable outcomes — adoption, throughput, cycle time, quality, administrative burden — and let the data drive what you do next.

What We’re Looking For

We’re optimizing for raw ability and drive over years of experience. If you can point to times you figured hard things out and got them done — in a job, a startup, a research project, a side project, or school — we want to hear from you.

  • Smart, and a fast learner who gets up to speed on unfamiliar domains, tools, and systems quickly.
  • A genuine love of efficiency and automation — you instinctively look for the repetitive task and the tool that could kill it.
  • High ownership and strong bias toward action: as ready to write the training doc and sit with a front-line user as to design the process.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and an early-stage environment where the playbook doesn’t exist yet — you’ll help write it, improvise, and adjust as things change.
  • Analytical instincts: you can define what “better” means, pull and read the data, and use it to prioritize.
  • Strong written and verbal communication — able to summarize the takeaway for a leader and get into the tactical weeds with an execution team.
  • Hands-on with everyday tools (spreadsheets, docs, dashboards) and eager to pick up whatever the job needs; light scripting, SQL, or no-code experience is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Willingness to work in a hybrid environment with travel to Habitat Health centers as needed.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to healthcare, value-based care, provider or payer operations, Medicare, Medicaid, PACE, or complex care delivery — or genuine curiosity about it.
  • Experience driving adoption of new tools or workflows across distributed, front-line teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Epic, or healthcare data (EHR, referral, or enrollment data).
  • A track record of teaching yourself the tool you needed to get something done.

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $125,000–$160,000 for candidates located in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle, and $118,000–$137,000 for candidates located elsewhere. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 10% of the base salary and may be eligible for additional incentive compensation, as applicable.

The final compensation offered will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, certifications, geographical location, and business needs.

In addition, this position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 401(k) savings plan that includes a match; paid time off; and company paid holidays.

At-Will Employment

Employment with Habitat Health is at-will. This means that either the employee or the employer may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without notice, subject to applicable law. Nothing in this job posting or any other company document is intended to create a contract of employment, express or implied, or to alter the at-will nature of employment.

Any written or oral statements to the contrary are not authorized unless made in writing and signed by an authorized representative of the Company.

Because this is a remote position, employment will be governed by the laws applicable to the employee’s work location, and applicable legal requirements will be followed.

Vaccination Policy, including COVID-19

To help maintain a safe environment for our participants and team members, Habitat Health maintains vaccination and infection control policies applicable to certain roles and work locations. For COVID-19 and influenza, team members who are working in a participant care setting are required to provide either proof of vaccination or a signed declination form and comply with applicable masking requirements while in a care setting to the extent permitted by law in the applicable jurisdiction.

Habitat Health will consider requests for reasonable accommodation based on an applicant's disability, medical condition, or sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance in accordance with applicable law.

As a condition of employment, team members are expected to comply with all applicable infection control protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and vaccination requirements associated with their role and work location, and to the extent required by law and as permitted in the applicable jurisdiction.

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity and Inclusion

Habitat Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to the principles of equal opportunity and inclusion. Employment decisions at Habitat Health are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, reproductive health decision-making, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

E-Verify Participation Notice

If E-Verify cannot confirm your authorization to work, Habitat Health will provide you with written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and/or the Social Security Administration (SSA) to resolve the issue before any adverse employment action is taken, including termination of employment.

Beware of Scams and Fraud

Regional Specialists (RS) are an integral part of Remote Research Clinicians (RRC) visit delivery, serving as a key liaison between clinical teams, remote research clinicians, and investigator sites to support the successful execution of remote and decentralized trial visits. The RS works in close partnership with the RRC Lead, providing operational, technical, and administrative support across assigned studies to help mitigate risk, control costs, support project timelines, and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will support remote visit execution through detailed coordination activities, including documentation review, visit and clinician coordination, system and tracker maintenance, and ongoing communication with internal and external stakeholders. The RS operates with a strong sense of urgency aligned to customer and study timelines and demonstrates a high level of attention to detail in all aspects of study support.

• Train and onboard research clinicians, ensuring they are prepared and study-ready.

• Manage access to systems like Study Hub and Thinking Cap for both site staff and clinicians.

• Receive and process Visit Request Forms (VRFs).

• Assign and confirm clinicians for remote visits.

• Coordinate visit logistics including supplies, equipment, and courier services.

• Ensure all required documentation (e.g., DOA logs, clinician credentials) is complete and uploaded.

• Maintain and update Smartsheet trackers for sites, visits, and clinicians.

• Perform quality checks on source documents and ensure timely corrections.

• Review uploaded documents in Study Hub and notify relevant stakeholders.

• Deliver study-specific training to sites and clinicians.

• Ensure compliance with GCP, ICH, HIPAA, and IQVIA SOPs.

• Serve as the primary liaison between sites, clinicians, and internal study teams.

• Provide ongoing support and retraining to clinicians and sites as needed.

• Escalate issues to RRC Lead and ensure resolution.

  • Bachelor's degree (B. A. / B. S.) from four-year college or university or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that provides the individual with the required knowledge, skills, and abilities.

We are seeking a Senior iOS Engineer to own the client side implementation of how members join, pay, and stay with Raya. Member Experience owns the full member lifecycle - applying, onboarding, payments, and lifecycle management - and this role owns the surfaces where that lifecycle becomes revenue: the paywall, the purchase experience, and the subscription state a member sees in the app.

This is a payments specialist role, not a generalist iOS role with some payments attached. The person we hire has built and operated native Apple StoreKit2 integrations more than once, with total depth and ownership - they wrote the integration, shipped it, and were still there when the edge cases showed up. They also bring production Stripe experience for a consumer product. They will work as a close peer to our server team, which owns App Store Server Notifications V2, entitlement source of truth, and reconciliation.

Responsibilities

  • Own the iOS subscription and payments stack end to end from product configuration, purchase and restore flows, entitlement state, offers, to the paywall surfaces members see.

  • Serve as the client-side authority on StoreKit2: architect the integration, set the patterns, and handle the lifecycle edge cases. Including interrupted and deferred purchases, upgrades, downgrades, crossgrades, refunds, revocations, billing retry, and price increase consent.

  • Partner closely with the server team on entitlement correctness, working across the client/server boundary on signed transaction verification, reconciliation, and idempotency so that what the app shows and what the backend believes never diverge.

  • Work with product, design, and data on pricing, offers, and paywall experimentation. Scoping and shipping revenue-affecting work from concept through launch and measurement.

  • Contribute broadly to a large, long-lived iOS codebase: architecture and system design, performance, testing practices, and deliberate management of tech debt.

  • Act as the client-side escalation point for member payment issues, with the monitoring and release discipline to catch problems before members do.

  • Raise the engineering bar through code review, technical mentorship, and clear written specs.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional iOS development experience, with strong proficiency in Swift, UIKit, MVVM, and reactive programming.

  • Expert-level, hands-on Apple StoreKit2 experience: you have built and operated StoreKit2 integrations end to end at least twice in production, owning product configuration, purchase and restore flows, Transaction.updates, current entitlements and subscription status, introductory / promotional / win-back offers, offer codes, and sandbox-through-production testing.

  • Direct, native StoreKit2 integration experience and depth that goes beyond consuming a third-party abstraction layer. You can reason about the framework itself.

  • Production Stripe Payments/Subscriptions experience for a B2C product (secondary to Apple, but required).

  • Experience collaborating with a server team on subscription correctness including App Store Server Notifications V2, signed transaction verification, reconciliation, and idempotent handling of duplicate events.

  • A track record of building and shipping consumer mobile applications to scaled audiences, with strong judgment on architecture, performance optimization, and user experience.

  • Strong consumer product sense and the ability to partner effectively with product, design, and data on revenue-affecting work.

  • Proven ability to lead projects from concept through launch, balancing speed and quality, and to own what you ship after it ships.

  • An AI-forward mindset, with curiosity about applying emerging technologies to improve developer and product experiences.

Nice to Have

  • Experience migrating a production app from StoreKit1 to StoreKit2.

  • Experience running a subscription product across two payment processors simultaneously, with a single active entitlement per member.

  • Familiarity with SwiftUI alongside UIKit, and with modularizing a large iOS codebase.

  • Experience with paywall and pricing experimentation frameworks, and with subscription analytics.

jobs.excerpt: ** This is an opportunity to lead and build the HR function at a fast-growing, remote-first company.
jobs.description:
** This is an opportunity to lead and build the HR function at a fast-growing, remote-first company. This position is fully remote (indefinitely). **

Emergent Software is seeking a relational, pragmatic, and results-driven Human Resources Manager to lead our HR function as the company grows. We are looking for a candidate who excels in sound judgment, honest communication, and building trust across an organization. Your primary responsibility will be to own the full range of day-to-day HR operations while serving as a trusted partner to leaders and managers across the company.

This role starts hands-on: you will personally own our core HR processes, develop a deep understanding of our employees and business, and identify opportunities to strengthen and scale how we support our people. Over time, you will build and lead an HR team, delegating operational work while maintaining accountability for the function. The Human Resources Manager will lead the HR function with the goals of:

  • Delivering reliable, responsive support to employees and managers throughout the employee lifecycle

  • Building HR processes, systems, and policies that stay consistent and scalable as we grow

  • Leading the people side of acquisitions so employees experience a smooth, well-communicated transition

Highlights & Benefits of working at Emergent Software

  • Work closely with other talented software engineers and analysts. Our vetting process means you can count on your team members to know what they are talking about.

  • Work from home or work remotely from anywhere you want

  • Flexible work schedule meaning you can work regular hours or whenever you work best

  • Work-life balance is essential and highly valued at Emergent Software. If you choose to work more than 40 hours, you’ll be compensated for the extra work!

  • Work on interesting projects solving complex business problems with custom software.

  • 100 hours per year to focus on your professional development. We invest in your growth!

  • Profit sharing bonus means as we’re successful, you’re successful

  • Excellent benefits package including medical insurance, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, FSA, disability, life insurance, and paid parental leave

Primary Duties

  • Own the day-to-day HR function, ensuring employees and managers have reliable, responsive support throughout the entire employee lifecycle.

  • Manage and continuously improve our HRIS and related people systems, including employee records, workflows, reporting, data integrity, and opportunities for automation.

  • Lead benefits and compensation practices, including annual enrollment, employee education, plan evaluation, broker relationships, market benchmarking, salary structures, internal equity, and compensation reviews.

  • Own HR policies, the employee handbook, and employment compliance across the multiple states where we employ people, keeping practices practical and consistent as the organization grows.

  • Manage employee relations matters, providing thoughtful and consistent guidance on performance concerns, workplace issues, conflict resolution, and disciplinary actions.

  • Coach and advise managers and company leadership on feedback, difficult conversations, employee development, team dynamics, and application of company policies.

  • Own the strategy behind performance and career development, equipping managers with the frameworks, tools, and guidance to run effective reviews, goal setting, feedback conversations, and development planning within their own teams.

  • Own onboarding and offboarding, creating a consistent employee experience while completing the operational, compliance, documentation, and communication steps of each transition.

  • Coordinate payroll and manage HR vendors and partners, working with finance, benefits providers, brokers, HR technology partners, and employment counsel to ensure accurate, well-supported HR operations.

  • Develop HR reporting and people metrics that give leadership visibility into headcount, turnover, retention, compensation, and workforce trends.

  • Lead the people-related integration of acquired companies: assessing HR practices, benefits, compensation, policies, and systems; transitioning employees into our programs; and partnering with leadership to communicate changes clearly.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive experience across a broad range of human resources responsibilities, including leading an HR function or serving in a HR leadership role.

  • Strong working knowledge of HR operations, employee relations, benefits, compensation, performance management, HR systems, and employment compliance.

  • Experience advising and coaching managers and senior leaders through complex employee and organizational situations.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate both strategically and hands-on, developing the approach and personally executing the work when necessary.

  • Experience creating, improving, and scaling HR processes within a growing organization.

  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive employee and company information.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven record of building trusted relationships at all levels of an organization.

  • Experience managing a workforce across multiple states.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, or organizational integrations

  • Experience building or developing an HR team

  • Experience in professional services, consulting, or a fully remote company

  • Experience with Rippling HRIS

  • HR certification such as SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or equivalent

Our Vetting Process

At Emergent Software, we work hard to find the right people to lead and support our team. If you think you’re one of them, please understand that the effort put into this by people like yourself helps us build a strong, trusted HR function. Here are the steps of our vetting process for this position:

  • Application (5 minutes)

  • Online Assessment (40-60 minutes)

  • Initial Phone Interview (45 minutes)

  • HR Experience & Skills Interview (30 minutes)

  • Executive Interview (60 minutes)

  • Job Offer!

Benefits Package Details

  • Medical Insurance: up to 80% of your monthly medical premium (HSA options available)

  • HSA Contribution: up to $144/month

  • Dental & Vision Insurance: up to 50% of your monthly dental and vision premium costs

  • 401(k) plan: company match up to 4% of salary

  • Profit sharing bonus: up to 20% of salary paid annually

  • Employee referral & customer referral bonuses

  • Flex Spending Account (FSA) for Dependent Care & Healthcare Costs

  • Dependent Care FSA Contribution: $90/month

  • Short Term Disability: $500/week for 12 weeks

  • Long Term Disability: up to $6,000/month

  • Group term life and AD&D insurance: $50k

  • PTO, standard holidays, 2 floating holidays

  • Paid parental leave: 2 weeks

  • Staff development program: 100 hours/year plus training costs

About Emergent Software

Emergent Software is a fast-growing software development, cloud consulting, and data engineering company serving clients across the country. We are regularly adding to our team of talented software engineers, cloud architects, data engineers, UX designers, technical product owners and more who can help us deliver high quality services for our clients.

We are a remote-first company

Since our inception, we've embraced a remote-friendly culture, promoting work flexibility beyond the norm. When the pandemic struck in 2020, our transition to fully remote work was seamless—just a matter of cleaning out the fridge. Recognizing an opportunity, we adopted a remote-first approach and began hiring talent from anywhere. We continue to offer our signature Minnesota-nice, Midwest-friendly attitude, ensuring everyone feels valued, whether or not they're familiar with the skyway system.

Your career grows with us

Working with talented individuals on interesting projects creates an engaging environment for software development enthusiasts. By working directly with our experienced team, participating in our staff development program, and solving complex problems across a variety of projects, you’ll find numerous opportunities for long-term career growth.

At Emergent Software, your ideas will be heard, you will grow exponentially as a master of your craft, and you will enjoy working other dedicated team members.

Check out what others say

Visit our Glassdoor page to discover how employees enjoy our remote working structure, flexible hours, profit sharing program, and more!

jobs.description:
Willkommen bei easybill.

22.000+ Unternehmen verlassen sich auf easybill. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Rechnungen, Prozesse und Integrationen im Alltag einfach laufen. Mit easybill-mobile bringen wir zentrale Funktionen unserer Plattform auf iOS und Android – und suchen dich, um die App technisch und produktseitig mitzugestalten.

Du bekommst klare Prioritäten, kurze Wege und Raum, um Dinge sauber zu lösen. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung: für technische Entscheidungen, durchdachte Nutzerführung und eine App, auf die sich unsere Kundinnen und Kunden unterwegs verlassen können.

Das ideale Profil? Du bist Freelancer und in TypeScript, React Native und Expo richtig tief drin, verstehst die Besonderheiten mobiler Anwendungen und möchtest ein Produkt in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase entscheidend prägen. Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony mit, um Funktionen auch auf Seiten unserer REST-API mitzugestalten.

Aufgaben

Du entwickelst easybill-mobile auf Basis von React Native, Expo und TypeScript für iOS und Android weiter. Eine technische Grundlage mit Anmeldung, Dashboard und Dokumentenübersichten ist bereits vorhanden. Darauf baust du auf und gestaltest die nächsten Schritte gemeinsam mit dem Team.

  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen rund um Rechnungen und Dokumente in verständliche mobile Abläufe und hochwertige native Oberflächen.
  • Du entwickelst die App-Architektur weiter und schaffst wartbare Strukturen für Navigation, wiederverwendbare Komponenten, Formulare und Datenzugriffe.
  • Du bindest unsere REST-API an und sorgst für verlässliches Datenmanagement: von typisierten Schnittstellen und Validierung bis zu Caching, Ladezuständen und Fehlerbehandlung.
  • Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen App und Backend. Bei Bedarf erweiterst du unsere REST-API auf Basis von PHP und Symfony, damit neue mobile Funktionen durchgängig umgesetzt werden können.
  • Du arbeitest an sicherer Authentifizierung, Session-Verwaltung und dem sorgfältigen Umgang mit sensiblen Kunden- und Geschäftsdaten.
  • Du behältst Performance und Plattformbesonderheiten im Blick – auch bei wechselnden Netzverbindungen, App-Wechseln und unterschiedlichen Geräten. Barrierefreiheit und Mehrsprachigkeit gehören für dich zur Produktqualität.
  • Du sicherst Änderungen mit automatisierten Tests und prüfst das Verhalten auf Simulatoren und echten Geräten. Du gestaltest Build-, Release- und Monitoring-Prozesse bis zur Veröffentlichung in den App Stores mit.
  • Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, bringst eigene Lösungsvorschläge ein und begleitest Funktionen von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und Weiterentwicklung.
  • Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge wie Claude Code intensiv im Entwicklungsalltag und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Qualität, Verständlichkeit und Korrektheit der Ergebnisse.

Unser Mobile-Stack umfasst React Native, Expo, Expo Router und TypeScript. Dazu kommen TanStack Query und TanStack Form, Zod und NativeWind. Für Tests setzen wir auf Jest und React Native Testing Library. Unsere bestehende Plattform und die REST-API basieren auf PHP und Symfony.

Qualifikation

  • Du musst nicht jede Bibliothek bereits kennen. Entscheidend ist, dass du deinen Stack verstehst, gute technische Entscheidungen triffst und dich selbstständig in neue Themen einarbeitest.
  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit TypeScript, React Native und Expo auf Senior-Level und hast mobile Anwendungen über die reine Implementierung hinaus bis zum Release begleitet.
  • Du verstehst React, Komponentenarchitektur, Zustandsverwaltung und asynchrone Datenflüsse und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich strukturieren.
  • Du kennst die Besonderheiten von iOS und Android und gehst systematisch an Performance-Probleme, Plattformfehler und Debugging heran.
  • Du bist sicher in der Anbindung von REST-APIs und verstehst API-Verträge, Authentifizierung, Validierung und Fehlerbehandlung.
  • Idealerweise bringst du zusätzlich Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony mit. Du kannst bestehende API-Endpunkte verstehen, Fehler zwischen App und Backend analysieren und Schnittstellen eigenständig erweitern.
  • Automatisierte Tests, nachvollziehbare technische Entscheidungen und wartbarer Code gehören für dich zum Entwicklungsalltag.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und pragmatisch, kommunizierst klar und behältst den Nutzen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden im Blick.

jobs.title: Account Executive - SaaS Sales, EMEA (202607)
jobs.excerpt: Digify is a cloud-based virtual data room and digital rights management software provider.
jobs.description:
Digify is a cloud-based virtual data room and digital rights management software provider. Our platform helps companies control, protect and track important documents after they have been shared.

Companies use Digify to protect confidential information for fundraising, M&A transactions, due diligence, intellectual property sharing and sensitive business communications. Today, Digify is used in 138 countries by more than 700,000 users worldwide.

THE ROLE

We are expanding our sales team and are looking for an Account Executive to support and grow our EMEA business.

This is an inbound-led SaaS sales role focused on SMB and mid-market customers. The first priority of the role is to manage and convert inbound demand from EMEA, including trial signups, general enquiries, quote requests and RFPs. As lead volume across EMEA can be high, the Account Executive must be strong at qualification, prioritisation and identifying the opportunities with the highest potential.

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded SaaS salesperson with 2–3+ years of experience and notable success in a sales or closing role. You should enjoy speaking with prospects, understanding their pain points, recommending suitable solutions, conducting product demos and following up closely to move deals towards close.

We are also open to exceptional candidates from an SDR/BDR background if they have demonstrated closing experience and are ready to take ownership of customer conversations through to close.

This is a remote role. Candidates should be based in a time zone that allows meaningful overlap with EMEA prospects and the Digify team.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

    • Manage inbound leads from EMEA, including trial signups, general enquiries, quote requests and RFPs.
    • Qualify leads effectively to understand fit, urgency, use case, buying intent and commercial potential.
    • Prioritise high-potential opportunities while managing a steady volume of inbound demand.
    • Speak with prospects over calls, emails and video meetings to understand their business needs and pain points.
    • Recommend suitable Digify solutions based on each prospect’s use case, requirements and buying context.
    • Conduct clear and effective product demos, with enough product understanding to address common technical and workflow-related questions.
    • Communicate Digify’s value proposition clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Follow up consistently and professionally to maintain deal momentum and move opportunities towards close.
    • Manage opportunities in HubSpot, keeping records accurate and up to date.
    • Share customer feedback, objections, market trends and competitive insights with the sales, product and marketing teams.
    • Work closely with the existing sales team to support territory transition, shared learning and EMEA sales growth.

Requirements

    • 2–3+ years of SaaS sales experience with notable success, preferably in a closing role.
    • Experience selling SaaS or cloud-based software products to SMB and/or mid-market customers.
    • Excellent lead qualification skills, with the ability to quickly assess fit, urgency and deal potential.
    • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritise effectively in a high-volume inbound environment.
    • Excellent communication skills, especially the ability to understand customer pain points and explain product value clearly.
    • Ability to build rapport and trust with prospects through calls, emails and online meetings.
    • Confidence conducting product demos and explaining technical concepts in a simple, practical way.
    • Ability to make sound and reasonable product recommendations based on customer needs.
    • Strong follow-up discipline and the ability to create urgency and maintain deal momentum in a professional, consultative way.
    • Strong written and spoken English. Additional European languages, such as German or French, are a plus.
    • Comfortable selling across different EMEA markets, with sensitivity to different business cultures, languages and buying contexts.
    • Familiarity with CRM tools, preferably HubSpot.
    • Comfortable using AI tools to improve sales productivity, including call preparation, prospect research, follow-up drafting and CRM updates.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience selling document security, data room, cybersecurity, legal tech, fintech, investment, M&A, or other B2B software solutions.
  • Experience handling inbound trial-led or product-led growth sales motions.
  • Familiarity with data protection, document security, due diligence or compliance-related buyer concerns.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A successful Account Executive in this role will be able to:

  • Quickly identify which inbound leads are worth prioritising.
  • Understand the prospect’s real business problem, not just respond to surface-level requests.
  • Recommend the right Digify solution in a consultative and credible way.
  • Deliver effective product demos independently.
  • Maintain strong follow-up discipline and keep deals moving.
  • Convert qualified EMEA inbound demand into paying customers.
  • Build trust with SMB and mid-market prospects across different EMEA markets.
  • Contribute useful market and customer insights back to the wider team.

Learn more about Digify by visiting our website.

Updated/Reviewed 04.08.26

Social Media Pack Leader

Job Industry: Charity / Social Services / Non- Profit Organization

Position Name: Social Media Department Leader for Dog Rescue - Volunteer (Unpaid)

Job Location: Spokane, Washington, United States

Job Type: Part Time

Office Setting: Fully Remote

Remote: Yes

Compensation: Volunteer

Hours Per Week: 5-8 (flexible)

Role Mission

This role leads, mentors and trains the Social Media Pack, overseeing the Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok teams. This position will receive digital marketing assets and Social Media requests from other Packs in the Rescue. They will organize, track, delegate and supervise the completion of the project while ensuring cohesive branding, mission and messaging across various channels.

This leader also stays actively involved in current Rescue operations and needs, ensuring that our social media content accurately reflects and supports the ongoing work of the Rescue.

What Winning Looks Like

Key Results Area #1 - Leadership

  • Upholds and models Rescue Core Values

  • Strives for continued education

  • Leads and mentors the different teams within the Social Media Pack: Facebook, Instagram, Tiktok and Youtube

  • Collaborates closely with other Pack Leaders as necessary

Key Results Area #2 - Overall Branding and Messaging

  • Ensures cohesive mission, messaging and branding across social medial channels, while respecting each platforms unique audience and tone

  • Keeps PHR's online presence and tone, professional and on brand

  • Keeps up to date with Social Media trends

Key Results Area #3 - Digital Marketing & Social Media Campaigns

  • Creates and maintains social media calendar

  • Aware of Rescue goals and current campaigns with flexibility for urgent and time sensitive campaigns

  • Receives Social Media requests from other Packs in the Rescue; delegates, organizes and supervises projects ensuring asset delivery by deadline

Analyzes insights and data on the different platforms, types of content, and other relevant data points to increase organic audiences

Needed Skills

  • Leadership experience in a remote environment

  • Social Media platform management experience

  • Ability to handle many different projects and campaigns at once across several teams

  • Strong written communication skills with non marketing personnel as well as other marketing branch roles
  • Unique Company Culture and Mission

Our Mission

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.

Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one 'dog destination' in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokane's love of Rescue Dogs.

Core Values:

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Community - dog loving people who treat each other well

Integrity - doing what you say will do

Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated

Our Company Culture

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, love freedom and love Jesus.

No NGO status here, we don't take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. We're about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We don't do drama. There are no victims here and the system isn't out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We don't bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where it's normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dog's birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isn't being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

AI Solutions Architect / Copilot Developer

Human-centered problem-solving meets Microsoft AI technology

Role Overview

We're looking for someone who thinks like a strategist, debates like a philosopher, and builds like an engineer. This role sits inside our AI Solutions Group, where the individual will need to reason clearly about ambiguous problems, build consensus among stakeholders, and translate that thinking into working solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform.

You'll partner directly with clients to figure out where AI can provide tangible improvements, gather and interpret requirements (even when clients aren't sure what they need), build solutions using Power Platform tools, help test and validate what you've built, and keep it optimized over time. This role is about people, logic, and persuasion as much as it is about implementation.

Why This Role Is Different

We believe the core skills for working effectively with AI aren't primarily technical. They're:

  • Creative problem solving: finding non-obvious paths through ambiguous, messy, or "less than optimal" situations
  • Strategic thinking: seeing the whole system, not just the ticket in front of you
  • Logic and structured reasoning: the same discipline that makes a good philosopher makes a good prompt engineer and a good solution architect
  • Communication and diplomacy: building consensus among stakeholders with competing priorities, teaching non-technical teams, and handholding through change

If you have a background in philosophy, strategy consulting, teaching, mediation, debate, logic, systems thinking, or similar disciplines, and you're excited by AI tools, we want to talk to you, even if your technical resume looks nontraditional.

What You'll Actually Do

With Clients

  • Act as a trusted advisor: ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and help clients articulate problems they haven't fully defined yet
  • Build consensus across stakeholders with different, sometimes conflicting, priorities. This is often the hardest part of the job
  • Teach and support end users through change, including patient handholding for less AI-fluent teams
  • Translate business problems into technical requirements, and technical constraints back into plain language

Building the Solution

  • Design and develop solutions in Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and related Power Platform tools
  • When necessary, integrate adaptive cards, connectors, triggers, and APIs to extend functionality
  • Craft effective prompts and grounding strategies for Copilot, Claude, and related AI tools. This is applied logic and language craft as much as coding
  • Build and prototype using Copilot-related AI tools for development and automation, always within strict data-control guardrails
  • Where possible, apply this same workflow to working with Anthropic’s Claude

Keeping It Working

  • Participate in testing, validation, and quality assurance
  • Support ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and enhancement of deployed solutions
  • Document decisions and create user guides that make adoption easier, not harder
  • Escalate and resolve issues, mentoring teammates along the way

Staying Sharp

  • Continuously evaluate new AI tools and platforms, with a healthy respect for compliance, governance, and data protection in a regulated environment
  • Bring an "AI mindset": curious, experimental, but never careless with sensitive data

What We're Looking For

Core (non-negotiable) skills:

  • Strong critical thinking and structured reasoning: you can break down a fuzzy problem into a clear plan
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to and persuade skeptical or non-technical audiences
  • Diplomacy and consensus-building, with comfort navigating disagreement without avoiding it
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and a track record of picking up new tools quickly
  • Comfort improvising solutions to non-technical problems, including political, organizational, or human friction, not just code bugs

Technical qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or real-world experience equivalent, any field, with philosophy, humanities, and social sciences welcome, and 3+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Hands-on experience (or strong aptitude to quickly gain it) with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) and Copilot Studio
  • Familiarity with modern AI tools, especially Microsoft Copilot and Claude, including prompt engineering and LLM behavior
  • Ability to work within a regulated environment with strict data controls, balancing experimentation against compliance

Preferred:

  • Background in strategy consulting, teaching, philosophy, logic, mediation/facilitation, or debate
  • Understanding of Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and system integrations
  • Experience with RAG-based architectures
  • Certifications in Power Platform, AI, or Copilot-related specialties
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery

Work Environment

  • Location: United States, Eastern Time Zone
  • Travel: None required
  • Schedule: Remote-first, asynchronous-friendly, with some real-time overlap for meetings and collaboration

The Bigger Picture

This is a strategic development role on a high-performing team helping organizations reimagine how they work with AI, using Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot, Claude, and beyond. The technology moves fast, and we have a need for people who can think clearly, communicate persuasively, and navigate ambiguity with grace. If that's you, let’s talk.

The Department of War (DoW) Test Resource Management Center (TRMC) plays a critical role in ensuring our warfighters maintain a decisive edge. TRMC ensures that the DoW components possess the appropriate test and evaluation (T&E) infrastructure required to develop and field military systems. Scientific Research Corporation supports TRMC by providing a Systems Engineering and Technical Advisory (SETA) support staff. This team delivers specialized technical expertise, engineering oversight, program management, and acquisition support to help the government design, manage, and deliver complex systems, in this case unique test infrastructure.

The ideal candidate will be a transonic and supersonic wind tunnel subject matter expert with strong documentation and communication skills, personal accountability, and a desire to work as part of a collaborative team. This role is a critical part of the government’s oversight team, serving as the technical lead and trusted technical advisor for a cutting-edge hypersonic T&E infrastructure project. You will be responsible for the government-side oversight of a state-of-the-art high-speed / transonic and supersonic wind tunnel test capability.

Under the oversight of the Chief Engineer and in coordination with other Test Facility Lead Engineers and the Construction Lead, the candidate will:

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-Augmented QA Engineer to own and expand automated testing for an early-stage, fast-moving security platform.

You’ll work closely with frontend and backend engineers to build reliable test coverage, strengthen the existing Playwright test suite, and ensure critical product workflows remain stable as the platform evolves.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll have significant ownership. You’ll receive clear goals around test coverage and reliability rather than step-by-step instructions, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working independently and improving systems proactively.

What You’ll Own

Test Automation & Coverage

  • Write and maintain automated end-to-end tests using Playwright
  • Expand coverage across critical product workflows
  • Build regression tests that run automatically on every pull request
  • Test workflows including dashboards, detection workflows, device management, user permissions, and settings
  • Keep the test architecture clean, maintainable, and scalable as the product grows

Test Infrastructure & Reliability

  • Own the reliability of the automated test suite and CI pipeline

  • Manage test data and seed data requirements

AI-Assisted Exploratory Testing

  • Work with Claude and LLM-based tools as part of daily testing workflows
  • Experiment with AI-driven testing approaches beyond scripted test cases
  • Identify issues that traditional automated regression tests may not catch
  • Continuously explore ways to improve QA efficiency through AI tooling

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work directly with frontend and backend engineers throughout the development cycle
  • Collaborate on testing requirements and critical product flows

Requirements

  • Strong TypeScript skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable test code

  • Familiarity with Claude or other AI/LLM-based development and testing tools
  • Experience working with React applications
  • Familiarity with Sentry, GCP Stackdriver, or similar observability tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Prefer building automated testing systems over relying primarily on manual QA
  • Enjoy improving test coverage and reliability proactively
  • Can work independently from high-level goals
  • Are comfortable diagnosing problems rather than waiting for detailed instructions
  • Have strong curiosity about AI-assisted testing and emerging tools
  • Enjoy working directly with engineers in a small, fast-moving team

  • Think beyond individual test cases and consider the reliability of the overall QA system

Tech Stack

  • Playwright — E2E testing framework
  • Claude & AI tooling — AI-assisted exploratory testing
  • React — Frontend application
  • Sentry — Error monitoring
  • GCP Stackdriver — Logging and observability

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: MD / VA

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision
  • Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes
  • Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation
  • Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment
  • Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive
  • Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply
  • Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles
  • Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win

  • Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed
  • Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly
  • Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization
  • Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required

  • 8 or more years of relevant experience across technology, solution design, and customer-facing communication
  • Pre-sales or customer-facing technical experience
  • Broad technical depth across two or more of: cloud, HPC, AI and machine learning infrastructure, data management, core infrastructure, analytics, or financial and business applications. A career built entirely inside storage is not what we are looking for
  • A track record of selling on value: uncovering what the customer is trying to accomplish and connecting technology to business, operational, and financial outcomes

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to challenge assumptions and help customers think through complicated decisions
  • Curiosity, empathy, an open mind, and a genuine appetite for continuous learning
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • BS in CS, EE, another technical degree, or equivalent experience

  • Familiarity with HPC and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation
  • Knowledge of current and emerging storage architectures (FC, iSCSI, NAS, SAN, object) and file systems
  • Linux, NFS, and distributed Linux environments
  • VMware, Ethernet, TCP/IP, and general networking
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP, and hybrid or cloud-native architectures

About the Indigenous Stewardship Network

The Indigenous Stewardship Network (ISN) is an emerging non-profit organization created in 2022 under a Tribal Charter with the Yurok Tribe. This Native-controlled and Native-led organization was established to bring people together who are committed to advancing community health and wellbeing, traditions and cultural values through Indigenous-led stewardship. While gatherings on these important issues have occurred informally, there is a need for an organized and dedicated support system to coordinate efforts more intentionally for Indigenous land stewardship practitioners in what is colonially known as California. ISN’s core programmatic focus is to establish and leverage a network to develop strategies, models, investments as well as other opportunities that strengthens Indigenous stewardship. ISN is currently in its initial growth phase and seeking an Administrative Assistant to assist the Executive Director and Board of Directors to help lead the organization through this phase.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Network Director, the Administrative Assistant will oversee daily administrative operations, and support human resources functions. This role will be responsible for maintaining records, handling correspondence, assisting with budgeting and expense tracking, processing financial transactions, and supporting fundraising efforts. The role also involves assisting Human Resources with basic duties and supporting governance and compliance requirements. The ideal candidate will demonstrate proficiency in managing office operations, basicfinancial processes, exposure to HR functions, program logistics, and communication strategies, with a strong ability to work with tribal, state, and federal governments and an appreciation for Indigenous stewardship practices.   • Ensure compliance with nonprofit regulations and reporting requirements.

  • Assist with grant applications and reporting.

Is experienced in processing invoices, reimbursements, and payments. Has experience collaborating with finance partners to ensure accurate financial records. Is proficient in managing donor databases and processing donations to support fundraising efforts.

Is experienced in assisting with the planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs and initiatives. Is experienced in managing logistics for events, workshops, and outreach activities with efficiency. Has functional knowledge in effective methods for tracking program data reporting.

  • Governance and Compliance:Has functional knowledge of nonprofit board governance management including preparing meeting agendas, minutes, and reports with accuracy. Has functional knowledge of compliance with nonprofit regulations and reporting requirements.

  • Adaptability and Resilience:Multitasks efficiently and adapts to shifting priorities and unforeseen challenges while maintaining a high level of productivity. Demonstrates resilience and flexibility in a dynamic work environment, consistently seeks solutions to complex problems. jobs.description:
Requisition ID

2026-4659

Job Summary

As a Junior Communications & Technical Writing Specialist supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI), aligned with the Strategic Planning Division (SPD) within Planning, Innovation & Modernization (PIM), you will provide day-to-day technical writing, editing, and communications product support to the program. Working under the direction of the contract’s Program Director and senior communications staff, you will draft, edit, format, and quality-check the recurring written products and communications materials that keep SPD/CCPI leadership, staff, pilot teams, and other stakeholders informed across the program’s portfolio across multiple, concurrent pilots.

This is a support-oriented, writing-focused role suited to a detail-oriented communications or technical-writing professional who can translate program, pilot, and policy information into clear, accurate, well-organized content and hold it to a consistent editorial standard. The role centers on producing and quality-controlling written communications products; all external-facing content and stakeholder decisions remain subject to Government review, approval, and release authority.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Draft, write, and edit recurring SPD/CCPI communications products — including social media content, press-release support materials, and one-pagers — for senior staff review and Government approval prior to release.
  • Provide technical writing and editing support across written work products developed under the task order, gathering and analyzing program, pilot, and policy information and translating it into clear, accurate, audience-appropriate documents for technical and non-technical readers.
  • Perform structured quality-control review of written deliverables — checking grammar, factual accuracy, terminology, and consistency of voice and style against SPD/CCPI, VHA, and VA guidance — before submission and escalate substantive or sensitive content to senior communications staff or the contract-aligned Program Director.
  • Independently verify quantitative claims, program status representations, and cited references in written products against authoritative source documentation prior to inclusion in a deliverable.
  • Edit and format written products, including reports, briefing materials, and presentations, to meet Section 508 accessibility standards before submission for Government review.
  • Draft and format content for weekly team updates and weekly briefing-deck compilation, ensuring consistency with approved templates and prior approved materials.
  • Maintain the weekly communications tracker, keeping records of product status, review cycles, and distribution current for the communications team.
  • Support the monthly outreach-material refresh by drafting and updating existing communications content for accuracy and currency under the direction of senior communications staff.
  • Provide writing and editing support for recurring program documentation, such as meeting agendas, minutes, and status-report narratives, prepared for SPD/CCPI leadership and program teams.

Warum TÜV Seminare Saarland?

Seit vielen Jahren begleiten wir Unternehmen und Fachkräfte mit hochwertigen Weiterbildungsangeboten in den Bereichen Technik, Management und Sicherheit. Unsere Seminare verbinden aktuelles Fachwissen mit einem hohen Praxisbezug – getragen von Expertinnen und Experten, die ihre Erfahrungen aus dem Berufsalltag einbringen.

Als Teil unseres Expertenkreises profitieren Sie von einer professionellen Organisation, einem etablierten Kundenstamm und einem starken Netzwerk. Sie konzentrieren sich auf das, was Sie am besten können: Ihr Wissen weitergeben. Wir übernehmen den Rest.

Aufgaben

Durchführung von Seminaren im Bereich Gebäudetechnik in einem oder mehreren der nachfolgenden Schwerpunktbereiche:

  • Zur Prüfung befähigte Personen von definierten und festgelegten Schlauchleitungen
  • Fortbildung für die zur Prüfung befähigte Person von definierten / festgelegten Schlauchleitungen

Qualifikation

Fachliche Qualifikation (zwingend erforderlich)

  • Studium oder Handwerks-/Technikermeister: Ein abgeschlossenes ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Fluidtechnik) oder eine Qualifikation als staatlich geprüfter Techniker bzw. Industriemeister im Bereich Metall/Anlagenbau.]
  • Zusatzqualifikation: Der Dozent muss selbst die Qualifikation als „Zur Prüfung befähigte Person für Schläuche und Rohrleitungen“ bzw. „Druckgeräte und Schlauchleitungen“ nach TRBS 1203 besitzen.

Berufserfahrung und zeitnahe Tätigkeit sowie spezifisches Fachwissen (Theorie und Normung)

Der Dozent muss exzellente Kenntnisse der einschlägigen rechtlichen und technischen Regelwerke besitzen, insbesondere:

  • Langjährige Praxis: Mehrjährige (oft gefordert: mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre) praktische Erfahrung in der Projektierung, Konfektionierung, Montage, Wartung oder Prüfung von Schlauchleitungen in Industrieanlagen. [1, 2]
  • Aktueller Bezug: Eine „zeitnahe berufliche Tätigkeit“ im entsprechenden Fachbereich (analog zu den Anforderungen der TRBS 1203 für Prüfer), um sicherzustellen, dass der Dozent den aktuellen Stand der Technik vermittelt.
  • Gesetze und Verordnungen: Betriebssicherheitsverordnung (BetrSichV), Technische Regeln für Betriebssicherheit (insb. TRBS 1201 und TRBS 1203).
  • Dampfspezifische Normen: Tiefgehendes Wissen über die physikalischen Besonderheiten von Sattel- und Heißdampf (z. B. Gefahren durch unkontrollierten Dampfaustritt, Auslegung nach DIN EN ISO 6134 für Dampfschläuche).
  • Flüssigkeitsspezifische Normen: Kenntnisse über Chemie-Schlauchleitungen (z. B. EN 12115) sowie das Verhalten von aggressiven, brennbaren oder toxischen Flüssigkeiten unter Druck

Didaktische und Pädagogische Kompetenz

Über Fachwissen hinaus müssen Sie als Dozent in der Lage sein, Lerninhalte verständlich zu vermitteln.

  • Pädagogische Eignung: Erfahrung in der Erwachsenenbildung, nachweisbar durch Train-the-Trainer-Zertifikate oder eine Ausbildereignungsprüfung (AdA-Schein) und die Fähigkeit, theoretische Vorschriften (wie Schadensszenarien oder Gefährdungsbeurteilungen) anhand von realen Fallbeispielen und Praxisübungen verständlich zu erklären.
