jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to own quality for our AI voice virtual agent.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to own quality for our AI voice virtual agent. This role is for someone who is equally comfortable reasoning about a large language model's behavior and reading a SIP trace.

You should be interested in testing non-deterministic systems. A voice agent takes a live phone call, transcribes speech that may be accented or noisy, interprets intent, reasons over an LLM, generates a spoken reply, and decides whether to resolve the request or hand it to a human—all within a latency budget callers will notice. Nothing in that chain can be validated with a simple assertion of equality, so you will design the evaluation approach that makes it testable anyway.

You should also be interested in the underlying telephony. Testing this agent means placing real calls: provisioning SIP endpoints and softphones, driving calls programmatically, controlling media conditions, and distinguishing a model failure from a codec, jitter, or call-routing issue.

  • PLEASE SUBMIT CV IN ENGLISH.
  • ONLY ACCEPTING CANDIDATES FROM LATAM.
  • ADVANCED SPOKEN ENGLISH IS REQUIRED.

Responsibilities

  • Embed fully within a Scrum team, participating in all ceremonies and maintaining associated artifacts.

  • Own the end-to-end test strategy for the AI voice virtual agent across the LLM, speech, and telephony layers.

  • Design test scenarios for complex conversational behavior, including multi-turn dialogues, interruptions and barge-in, ambiguous or incomplete input, out-of-scope requests, human escalation/transfer, and failure recovery.

  • Build and maintain an evaluation framework for non-deterministic output, leveraging golden datasets, semantic/rubric-based assertions, and automated regression detection for prompt, model, or retrieval changes.

  • Adversarially test the agent against hallucinations, incorrect grounding, guardrail bypasses, prompt injections, and unauthorized disclosure of customer data.

  • Prepare and provision SIP devices, endpoints, and call scenarios to automate call origination end-to-end.

  • Diagnose failures across the entire stack, isolating issues down to the LLM, ASR (speech recognition), TTS (text-to-speech), media path, or call routing layer.

  • Extend automated coverage and integrate test suites into the CI/CD pipeline to serve as release gates.

  • Define and track core quality metrics, including task completion, containment, intent accuracy, transcription accuracy, response latency, and escalation correctness.

  • Maintain documented test coverage in the TMS with full traceability to business requirements.

  • Communicate and escalate quality risks to stakeholders backed by data and evidence.

Requirements:

    • 5+ years in QA, with recent hands-on ownership of a complex, integrated product.

    • Practical experience testing SIP/VoIP systems, including call flows, SIP signaling, media handling, softphones, or SIP trunking, with the ability to troubleshoot using SIP traces or packet captures.

    • Demonstrated creativity in test design (live scenario design will be a core part of the interview process and heavily weighted).

    • Proficiency in Python, sufficient to independently build and maintain automation frameworks.

    • Experience testing non-deterministic or probabilistic systems, with a clear approach to designing assertions for variable outputs.

    • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to define quality metrics, justify their calculation, and use data to back release decisions.

    • Hands-on experience with formal TMS tools and Jira.

    • Professional fluency in English (spoken and written), with reliable overlap with US Eastern business hours.

We use the following technologies:

  • Python with pytest for test automation.

  • Playwright for browser and WebRTC-based call driving.

  • JsSIP / WebRTC for programmatic call origination and media control.

  • SIP softphones and devices for manual and exploratory testing.

  • Allure TestOps as our TMS, linking automated runs to documented test cases.

  • Jira for project management and issue tracking.

  • Jenkins & GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines.

  • Grafana for quality and delivery metrics.

  • LLM APIs and evaluation tooling — currently in active development, and we are open to any effective approach.

Pluses:

  • Direct experience testing LLM-based or conversational AI products, including evaluation frameworks and LLM-as-a-judge approaches.

  • Familiarity with speech technologies, including ASR/transcription accuracy measurement (WER), TTS quality assessment, endpointing, and silence detection.

  • Experience with RAG or retrieval-grounded systems, specifically in evaluating grounding correctness and context retrieval.

  • WebRTC and media-layer testing experience, including codec behavior and performance degradation under jitter or packet loss.

  • Background in testing IVR, contact center, or conversational IVR platforms.

  • Multilingual testing capabilities, with emphasis on Spanish/English code-switching.

  • Literacy in prompt engineering, sufficient to analyze system prompts and identify potential failure modes

We are pleased to offer:

  • Remote work opportunity!

  • B2B Employment ($, gross).

  • Stable job with long-term growth perspective.

  • Competitive salary with annual performance review.

  • Really good hardware.

  • An exciting and challenging job with talented people around.

  • Continuous learning and career growth opportunities.

  • Compensation for professional training, seminars, and conferences.

  • Referral program: get rewarded for helping us grow the team with talented people.

  • Company-supported English classes to enhance your professional growth.

Creativity is a core requirement for this role, not a nice-to-have. The defects that matter here are found by someone who imagines the caller who interrupts mid-sentence, switches languages halfway through, gives a partial account number, answers a different question, or deliberately tries to jailbreak the agent. Scenario design is the primary skill we are hiring for.

Current State: We have automated call testing built on JsSIP/WebRTC with Python and Playwright, alongside a growing body of test scenarios. The evaluation layer—how we score responses consistently, catch regressions when a prompt or model changes, and report quality metrics leadership can act on—is where this role will have the most impact.

AI Marketing Specialist / Spécialiste en marketing IA

Spécialiste en marketing IA

Aperçu du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) spécialiste en marketing parfaitement à l'aise avec l'IA pour agir comme généraliste sur le terrain au sein de notre portefeuille de logiciels destinés au secteur des sciences de la vie et des essais cliniques. Ce rôle est axé sur l'exécution et convient parfaitement à une personne qui aime piloter des campagnes de bout en bout, qui reste très organisée et qui sait alterner entre travail créatif et travail opérationnel. La personne idéale se tient constamment à jour sur les derniers outils de marketing IA et cherche activement des façons d'utiliser l'IA agentique pour automatiser les flux de travail.

Vous serez responsable de la planification et de l'exécution de campagnes publicitaires numériques, de la création de matériel de marketing, du soutien à l'organisation de conférences et d'événements, et du maintien de l'avancement des initiatives marketing sans supervision constante.

Ce n'est pas un rôle restreint au « contenu seulement » ou aux « publicités seulement ». Nous cherchons une personne capable d'opérer sur plusieurs canaux, de gérer les détails avec rigueur et de croître vers des responsabilités accrues au fil du temps.

Principales responsabilités

Exécution de campagnes et marketing numérique

  • Planifier, lancer et gérer des campagnes publicitaires numériques (LinkedIn, Google, courriel et autres canaux B2B)
  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et fournir des rapports clairs sur ce qui fonctionne et ce qui ne fonctionne pas
  • Coordonner les échéanciers, les actifs et les approbations des campagnes auprès des parties prenantes internes

Matériel de marketing et contenu

  • Créer et maintenir le matériel de marketing, incluant des fiches d'une page, des présentations, des brochures, des études de cas et du contenu de site Web
  • Rédiger des textes clairs et professionnels pour les publicités, les pages de destination, les courriels et le matériel de soutien aux ventes
  • Adapter des sujets techniques ou complexes en messages destinés à la clientèle

Conception graphique

  • Concevoir des actifs visuels pour les campagnes numériques, les présentations, les conférences et les réseaux sociaux
  • Maintenir la cohérence de la marque dans tous les documents
  • Travailler avec les lignes directrices de marque existantes et les améliorer au besoin

Événements et conférences

  • Soutenir la planification et l'exécution de conférences et de salons professionnels
  • Coordonner la logistique des kiosques, de la signalisation, du matériel imprimé et des articles promotionnels
  • Participer à la promotion préévénementielle et aux campagnes de suivi postévénementielles

Excellence opérationnelle

  • Maintenir des plans de projet, des bibliothèques d'actifs et des calendriers de campagnes bien organisés
  • Gérer plusieurs initiatives simultanément sans négliger les détails
  • Repérer de façon proactive les lacunes, les retards ou les problèmes de qualité et les régler rapidement

Compétences et expérience requises

  • Parfaite maîtrise des outils et stratégies de marketing IA les plus récents
  • 3 à 7 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de marketing généraliste, idéalement dans le secteur des logiciels B2B ou des services technologiques
  • Solides compétences en rédaction, avec une capacité à écrire de façon claire, concise et professionnelle
  • Solides compétences en conception graphique avec des outils tels qu'Adobe Creative Suite, Figma ou Canva
  • Expérience dans la gestion ou le soutien de campagnes publicitaires numériques
  • Grande capacité d'organisation, souci du détail et rigueur dans les processus
  • À l'aise pour travailler de façon autonome en télétravail
  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais

Atouts

  • Expérience dans les sciences de la vie, la santé ou les essais cliniques
  • Connaissance du marketing auprès de publics réglementés ou hautement techniques
  • Expérience en soutien au marketing d'événements ou de conférences

À propos d'Anju Software

Anju Software offre des solutions de bout en bout pour l'industrie des sciences de la vie, en appuyant les essais cliniques, les affaires médicales et la gestion des données scientifiques avec précision, conformité et rigueur opérationnelle. Nos produits aident les entreprises pharmaceutiques, biotechnologiques et de dispositifs médicaux à commercialiser leurs thérapies plus rapidement et plus efficacement.

Anju fait partie de Valsoft Corporation, un acquéreur et exploitant mondial d'entreprises de logiciels de marché vertical. Valsoft investit avec une vision à long terme, permettant à chaque entreprise d'opérer de façon autonome tout en bénéficiant d'un capital partagé et d'une expertise opérationnelle commune.

Nous entamons une nouvelle phase de croissance axée sur l'intégration profonde de l'IA dans nos systèmes et processus. Nous sommes enthousiastes à l'idée d'accueillir des talents qui contribueront à mener notre transformation vers une organisation véritablement agentique et axée sur l'automatisation, redéfinissant la façon de travailler dans le secteur des sciences de la vie.

Équité en matière d'emploi

Anju Software est un employeur souscrivant au principe de l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi. Nous nous engageons à créer un milieu de travail inclusif et considérons toutes les candidatures qualifiées sans égard à la race, à l'origine nationale ou ethnique, à la couleur, à la religion, à l'âge, au sexe, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'identité ou l'expression de genre, à l'état matrimonial, à la situation de famille, aux caractéristiques génétiques ou au handicap, conformément à la Loi canadienne sur les droits de la personne et aux lois provinciales applicables en matière de droits de la personne.

Les candidat(e)s doivent être légalement autorisé(e)s à travailler au Canada.

AI Marketing Specialist

We are looking for a fully AI-fluent Marketing Specialist to act as a hands-on generalist across our portfolio of software products in the life sciences and clinical trials space. This role is execution-heavy and ideal for someone who enjoys owning campaigns end-to-end, staying highly organized, and switching between creative and operational work. The ideal candidate keeps fully up to date on the latest AI marketing tools and loves finding ways to use agentic AI to automate workflows.

You will be responsible for planning and executing digital advertising campaigns, creating marketing collateral, supporting conference and event execution, and keeping marketing initiatives moving forward without constant oversight.

This is not a narrow "content-only" or "ads-only" role. We are looking for someone who can operate across channels, manage details rigorously, and grow into increasing responsibility over time.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple initiatives simultaneously without dropping details

Nice to Have

About Anju Software

Anju Software delivers end-to-end solutions for the life sciences industry, supporting clinical trials, medical affairs, and scientific data management with precision, compliance, and operational rigor. Our products help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently.

Anju is part of Valsoft Corporation, a global acquirer and operator of vertical market software businesses. Valsoft invests with a long-term mindset, empowering each company to operate autonomously while benefiting from shared capital and operational expertise.

We are entering a new phase of growth, focused on embedding AI deeply into our systems and workflows. We are excited to add talent who will help lead our transformation into a truly agentic, automation-driven organization that redefines how work gets done in life sciences.

Equal Opportunity & Employment Equity

The Senior Materials Planning Specialist is the most senior technical role within the materials planning function, responsible for shaping and governing the planning frameworks that ensure reliable material supply across the manufacturing network. Operating with a network-level perspective, this role establishes and maintains the planning standards, MRP parameter strategies, and inventory governance practices that enable consistent, scalable planning performance across multiple sites.

Serving as a planning subject-matter expert, the Senior Materials Planning Specialist evaluates material flow dynamics, inventory positioning, supplier constraints, and system outputs to identify systemic planning risks and implement structural improvements. This role plays a central part in designing and optimizing ERP/MRP planning logic, strengthening master data governance, and improving planning system performance to support accurate planning signals and resilient supply execution.

This role partners closely with sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and supply chain leadership to align planning strategy with operational priorities and long-term business objectives. The Senior Materials Planning Specialist leads cross-site planning standardization efforts, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and provides advanced analytical insight that improves service levels, inventory health, and supply chain stability.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Planning and Scheduling

  • Own planning strategy for complex or high-impact materials across the network; establish planning approaches used across planners and sites.
  • Diagnose systemic MRP planning issues and redesign parameter logic, exception handling, and planning workflows to improve network performance.
  • Establish ordering strategies, replenishment frameworks, and exception management processes used across planning teams.
  • Lead resolution of complex supply disruptions and design contingency planning strategies to protect enterprise supply continuity.
  • Design the enterprise materials planning framework for commercialization readiness across multiple plants and product launches.
  • Drive enterprise improvements in planning KPIs through planning process design, parameter optimization, and cross-site alignment.

Inventory Health

  • Design network-level inventory strategies across plants to balance service risk, working capital exposure, and shelf-life constraints.
  • Identify systemic inventory risks across the network and implement structural improvements to planning policies and stocking strategies.
  • Influence enterprise planning strategies by analyzing multi-site demand patterns, inventory positioning, and supply constraints.
  • Establish standardized inventory planning frameworks and parameter governance across the planning organization.
  • Partner with Operations, Sourcing, and Quality to validate planning policies, stocking rules, and replenishment strategies that strengthen end-to-end material flow and planning visibility.

Supplier Relationship Management:

  • Provide enterprise visibility into supplier performance risks impacting multiple plants or product lines.

Administrative Support

What needs to be designed → how it needs to be fabricated → what materials are required → what the factory needs → what needs to happen next.

Strong communication is particularly important because this individual will work closely withfactories and suppliersand must be able to clearly communicate specifications, changes, requirements, and expectations.

Navarro Research and Engineering is recruiting an Applied Mechanical Engineer (3985) in a remote capacity with travel to Idaho Falls, ID as required.

Navarro Research & Engineering is an award-winning federal contractor dedicated to partnering with clients to advance clean energy and deliver effective solutions for complex challenges in the nuclear and environmental fields. Joining Navarro means being a part of an exceptional team committed to quality and safety while also looking for innovative strategies to create value for the client’s success. Headquartered in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, Navarro has active programs in place across the nation for DOE/NNSA, NASA, and the Department of Defense.

Position Summary

The Applied Mechanical Engineer provides applied mechanical engineering support for a novel advanced reactor design project. This position applies engineering principles to mechanical challenges involving the motion and dynamics of heat, gases, air, fluids, and solid materials to support the design of nuclear reactors and associated systems that operate safely, reliably, efficiently, and predictably.

The role performs system and component design, evaluation, documentation, testing, configuration management, fabrication oversight, and implementation in a multidisciplinary engineering environment. The engineer must be proficient in designing systems in accordance with applicable national consensus codes and standards, including the ASME B31 series and ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (BPVC).

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers in support of a novel advanced reactor design.
  • Perform mechanical system design and evaluation and support project completion and implementation activities.
  • Design reactor vessels in accordance with the ASME BPVC for high-temperature service, including creep and fatigue considerations.
  • Design high-temperature gaskets, sealing systems, and bolting.
  • Document electromechanical device designs, including controlled and approved models, drawings, specifications, and design descriptions for control rod or drum drive mechanisms, to demonstrate conformance with design requirements and applicable codes and standards.
  • Decompose project objectives into defined and controlled design requirements using a systems engineering approach and digital engineering tools to track requirements and design parameters.
  • Apply discipline best practices, design methodologies, technologies, and processes to develop and define designs and validate that each design meets established requirements.
  • Establish testing, inspection, and quality requirements to ensure that technical features important to design functions are maintained.
  • Oversee or otherwise ensure that fabrication, construction, assembly, and procurement activities are completed in accordance with the approved design.
  • Ensure that designs meet technical baseline requirements and applicable codes and regulations.
  • Develop, verify the adequacy of, and maintain configuration management for the technical baseline and assigned systems.
  • Ensure consistent operating characteristics across applicable drawings, technical manuals, operating instructions, and emergency operating procedures.
  • Coordinate with designers, customers, and analysts to develop experiment requirements, complete conceptual and final designs, follow fabrication and inspection activities, lead experiment assembly activities, support experiment installation and testing, and develop integrated analyses demonstrating that facility safety bases are met.
  • Perform design, fabrication, and associated activities supporting reactor operations and experimentation.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Lead Reactor Project Engineer or Engineering Manager.

Requirements

  • Proficiency in designing mechanical systems in accordance with applicable national consensus codes and standards, including the ASME B31 series and ASME BPVC.
  • Proven experience designing reactor vessels for high-temperature service with creep and fatigue considerations.
  • Proven experience designing high-temperature gaskets, sealing systems, and bolting.
  • Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles used to produce precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models.
  • Knowledge of the practical application of engineering science and technology, including the principles, techniques, procedures, and equipment used in the design and production of goods and services.
  • Ability to apply general rules to specific problems and produce logical solutions.
  • Ability to combine information to form general rules or conclusions, including identifying relationships among seemingly unrelated events.
  • Ability to listen to and understand information and ideas communicated verbally and to communicate technical information clearly so others understand.
  • Ability to recognize when a problem exists or is likely to occur.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting the design of novel or advanced nuclear reactors in a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Experience with systems engineering, digital engineering tools, requirements tracking, design parameter management, and configuration management.
  • Experience with electromechanical devices such as control rod or drum drive mechanisms.
  • Experience supporting fabrication, construction, assembly, procurement, inspection, experiment installation, testing, reactor operations, or experimentation.
  • Experience developing integrated analyses to demonstrate compliance with facility safety bases.

Education and Experience

Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering or a directly related field from an ABET-accredited program and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or a Master of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering or a directly related field from an ABET-accredited program and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience.

The candidate may work remotely but must be available to travel to Idaho as required.

Due to the nature of the government contract requirements and/or clearances requirements, US citizenship is required.

Navarro is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, religion, color, national origin, age, disability, veteran’s status, or any classification protected by applicable state or local law.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a Principal Analyst to join our GTM Analytics team, where we turn data into the insights that shape decisions across Sales, Strategy, RevOps, Marketing, Deal Desk, and more. In this role, you'll be a force multiplier for the senior manager and a technical anchor for the broader team, taking on the most complex and time-sensitive questions across the business. When a request genuinely calls for a dashboard, you'll shape the requirements and propose the logic for our central data team to build.

In this role, you'll handle the team's most ambiguous and time-sensitive requests — often scoping a question live, in a meeting with senior stakeholders, and turning it into a usable answer quickly. You'll build models that blend statistical rigor and financial fluency (forecasting, pipeline coverage, quota simulation), review and unblock work from other team members, and represent the team's analytical judgment in rooms the senior manager isn't always in.

This is a full-time position based out of our Costa Rica office.

Technologies You’ll Use

SQL, dbt, Looker, Omni, Sigma, Excel and/or Google Sheets (financial modeling), Hex or similar notebook tools (exploratory analysis), Python (statistical libraries), Salesforce, Claude (or similar AI assistants)

What You’ll Do

  • Translate ambiguous, often verbal requests from senior stakeholders into a scoped analytical plan in real time
  • Build and maintain complex models that combine statistical and financial methods (e.g., pipeline coverage, quota simulation, forecast accuracy)
  • Deliver fast, directionally-correct analysis under time pressure, then refine to full rigor when the deliverable warrants it
  • Represent the team's analytical judgment in meetings with VP+ stakeholders without requiring the manager's involvement
  • Reframe stakeholder questions when the request as asked doesn't match the underlying business problem
  • Review and unblock analytical work from Level 2 and Level 3 team members
  • Triage incoming requests and help route them appropriately across the team
  • Own end-to-end delivery of strategic, cross-functional analyses (e.g., account matching strategy, end-of-quarter deal pattern analysis)
  • Apply statistical methods (e.g., regression, confidence intervals, cohort analysis) to strengthen the rigor of insights
  • Collaborate with Finance's own analysts when a request touches revenue or forecasting logic, to make sure GTM models stay consistent with how Finance defines and tracks those numbers

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Advanced, self-serve proficiency in SQL, dbt, and BI tools (Looker, Omni, Sigma) — able to independently get, analyze, and visualize data with minimal support
  • Strong understanding of SaaS sales motions (opportunity stages, pipeline progression, SFDC structure) and working knowledge of financial/forecasting concepts (ARR, quota attainment, pipeline coverage, bookings) — enough to collaborate confidently with Finance's own analysts, not to replace them
  • Statistical knowledge (e.g., regression analysis, distributions, confidence intervals) applied to business problems
  • Analytical mindset with the judgment to reframe a stakeholder's question when it doesn't match the underlying business problem
  • Ability to quickly scope and prioritize ambiguous requests under time pressure, often live in meetings, and strong judgment on when to move fast vs. when to prioritize rigor
  • Experience reviewing or mentoring others' analytical work
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in front of senior or executive stakeholders

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience owning forecasting or planning methodology, not just reporting on it
  • Prior experience in FP&A or a quantitative finance role
  • Experience building simulation models
  • Some informal people leadership or team lead experience
  • Advanced Python (pandas, numpy, statsmodels)

Perks and Benefits

  • RSU stock grants*

  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

Qohash is building the zero copy data security control layer, enterprises need to adopt AI safely.

Our platform, Qostodian, helps large organizations discover, classify, govern, and remediate sensitive unstructured data across their most critical data sources without moving or copying the data. This zero copy architecture reduces exposure, preserves data sovereignty, and allows enterprises to secure data directly where it lives.

This matters because AI adoption is increasing the risk, complexity, and urgency of enterprise data security. Before organizations can safely deploy AI agents, copilots, retrieval systems, or automated workflows, they need to know where sensitive data lives, who and what can access it, and how to enforce controls at scale.

Company culture is at our core

Our 5 core values are more than just words, they are a way of life for us. We know that companies with a strong culture and a higher purpose perform better in the long run.

Do our values speak to you?

  • Pursuit of excellence
  • Resilience
  • Mission focus
  • Accountability
  • Embracing conflict

About the team

We are standing up a new team for the QSIDS (Qohash Sensitive Information Detection System) launch, dedicated to the detection engine. A central focus of this team is the integration of embedded AI, machine learning models that run directly on the device and in-system. It is about high-performance, low-resource, on-device inference, embedded into the detection engine itself. The engine is built in Go, with a strong emphasis on performance and minimal resource footprint.

Who you are

You're a hands-on Go developer who likes living close to the metal - profiling hot paths, trimming allocations, and making concurrent systems behave predictably under load. You enjoy integration work: wiring components, native libraries, and models into a coherent engine, and making the seams disappear. You take pride in owning what you ship, watching how it behaves in production and iterating to keep it fast and reliable. You bring strong engineering fundamentals, write tests as a matter of course, and collaborate naturally, helping the team converge on quality decisions. You're comfortable with the pace and ambiguity of a startup, and you care about the outcome, not just the code.

What you will do

  • Design and build a highly efficient cross-platform detection engine for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
  • Integrate embedded machine learning models into the engine for on-device inference, and own the runtime, bindings, and data paths that make them work in-system.
  • Collaborate closely with machine learning and systems colleagues to turn models into production-ready components.
  • Optimize end to end for latency, memory footprint, and CPU — profiling, benchmarking, and tuning both engine code and model execution.
  • Own features all the way to production including instrumenting, monitoring, and iterating to keep them reliable.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define milestones and ensure timelines align with development needs.
  • Participate in discussions on technological choices and decisions regarding product development.
  • Resolve anomalies and problems as soon as they arise.
  • Help onboard and train colleagues as the team grows.
  • Communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What your resume shows

Must Haves

  • 7+ years' experience building and shipping production software in Go
  • Strong systems programming fundamentals - memory management, concurrency, profiling, and software optimization in performance-sensitive, resource-constrained environments
  • Hands-on track record owning code post-deployment: instrumenting, debugging, and iterating on live systems
  • A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)

Nice to Haves

  • Experience embedding ML models for on-device inference (a strong asset for this role)
  • Experience with Rust, C/C++ or another low-level systems language
  • Experience building, training, or optimizing machine learning models, including compression, quantization, and tuning for low-latency inference
  • Bilingual (French and English)
  • Experience working in a startup environment

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive salary range.
  • Enjoy up to six weeks of paid time off annually. At Qohash, we recognize your dedication and believe in giving you ample time to rejuvenate.

Staff AI Data Engineer

Location: Remote (U.S.-based) Preference given to CA, TX, and FL
Department: Product
Reports to: Chief Product Officer
Starting Pay Range: $184k - $215k/yr

About Work Truck Solutions

Work Truck Solutions is the operating system for the commercial vehicle industry. While the retail auto market is saturated with software, the $130B+ commercial truck market was operating in the dark—until we turned on the lights.

We are the only platform that connects the entire ecosystem: OEMs, upfitters, dealerships, and fleet buyers. By digitizing complex inventory data (chassis + upfits) and streamlining the supply chain, we don't just help dealers sell trucks; we ensure American businesses get the mission-critical vehicles they need to work. We are a team of innovators, disruptors, and problem-solvers dedicated to one mission: removing the friction from the commercial vehicle industry. We are profitable, growing, and aggressively scaling our technology to remain the undisputed authority in this space.

The Opportunity

We have spent years assembling something no one else in this industry has: a connected view of what's being built, what's sitting on lots, what's moving, and what buyers are looking for and failing to find. Right now, a lot of that value is latent. It lives in our pipelines instead of in our customers' hands.

We are seeking a Staff AI Data Engineer to change that. This role exists to turn our data asset into products dealers, upfitters, and OEMs will pay for and rely on—market intelligence, demand and pricing signal, inventory recommendations, automated enrichment, search and matching that actually finds the right truck.

Your primary job is delivering customer-facing results from our data. That said, you'll need to be able to build the plumbing when it's in your way. The best people for this role don't wait on a ticket queue for a feature pipeline—they architect the ingestion and transformation they need, ship it, and hand it off cleanly. We're looking for someone who is fluent in both directions and clear about which one the moment calls for.

We also want someone genuinely eager about what AI makes possible here. The hardest parts of our data problem—unstructured spec sheets, inconsistent upfit descriptions, entity resolution across feeds that agree on nothing—are exactly the problems where modern AI and LLMs are a step change over what was possible three years ago. You should be excited to reach for those tools, rigorous about proving they worked, and honest when a simpler method wins.

How You'll Spend Your Time

Rough shape of the role, so there's no ambiguity about the emphasis:
  • ~60% productizing data. Building models, analyses, and data products that reach customers—forecasting, pricing signal, recommendations, matching, enrichment, market intelligence—and iterating on them based on how they actually get used.
  • ~25% AI-driven capability. Applying LLMs and ML to extract, structure, and enrich the data that makes those products possible, with the evaluation rigor to know it's working.
  • ~15% data engineering. Building the ingestion, transformation, and feature pipelines your work depends on, and setting standards others can follow.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver results from our data
  • Own customer-facing data products end to end: define the opportunity, build the model or analysis, ship it, measure whether it actually helped, and iterate.
  • Build the intelligence layer of our platform—demand forecasting, pricing and market signal, inventory and configuration recommendations, matching and ranking—on problems where being right has direct commercial consequence for our customers.
  • Partner with product and design on how model output surfaces to a dealer or upfitter, what happens when it's wrong, and how much confidence to express.
  • Work directly with customers and the commercial team to understand what decisions they're actually trying to make, and let that shape what you build.
  • Define and instrument success metrics for everything you ship; be the person who knows whether it worked.

Use AI to unlock the data
  • Apply LLMs to the unstructured layer of our business: extraction from spec sheets and vehicle descriptions, classification, taxonomy mapping, enrichment, semantic search and matching.
  • Build the evaluation infrastructure that makes AI output trustworthy—golden datasets, offline and online metrics, monitoring for degradation, and guardrails with sensible fallback behavior.
  • Bring AI into your own workflow aggressively and critically, and raise the practice of the people around you.
  • Make honest calls about where generative approaches beat classical ML or plain deterministic logic, and where they don't.

Build what you need
  • Design and build the ingestion, transformation, and feature pipelines your models depend on, rather than waiting for them.
  • Contribute to entity resolution and normalization systems that turn inconsistent supplier data into a trustworthy canonical record.
  • Establish data quality, lineage, and contract standards for the data your products rest on.
  • Partner with data engineering on the platform decisions that outlast any single project, and hand off what you build in a state others can own.

Raise the bar
  • Set the standard for analytical and modeling rigor through peer review, and mentor the analysts and engineers around you.
  • Write clearly enough that your findings change decisions and your systems can be maintained by someone else.

Qualifications

Data science and productization
  • 8+ years applying data science to real problems, with a track record of models and analyses that shipped to users and changed outcomes—not internal reports that circulated and stalled.
  • Demonstrated ownership of customer-facing data products, where your model's output was the product and its quality was visible to people paying for it.
  • Strong statistical foundation: experimental design, regression, uncertainty quantification, and the judgment to know what your assumptions are and what happens when they break.
  • Substantial applied modeling experience across the families that matter here—forecasting, recommendation and ranking, gradient boosting, segmentation, entity resolution and fuzzy matching, anomaly detection.
  • Genuine rigor about evaluation: offline metrics that predict online behavior, correct validation for temporal and grouped data, leakage awareness, and calibration—not just accuracy.
  • Product instinct. You care whether the customer's decision got better, not whether the model was interesting.

AI fluency and appetite
  • Hands-on production experience applying LLMs to data problems: structured extraction, classification and enrichment, embeddings for similarity and clustering, semantic search and matching over messy real-world text.
  • Experience building evaluation and guardrail systems for probabilistic output; you don't ship a prompt without a way to know when it degrades.
  • Working command of the production tradeoffs—model selection, structured output enforcement, context and token cost, latency, caching, human-in-the-loop review—and able to build a business case that accounts for them.
  • Actively curious about the frontier of these tools and eager to apply them, paired with the discipline to verify rather than assume.
  • Familiarity with agentic patterns and tool use, with a realistic view of where they're production-ready and where they aren't.
  • The judgment to argue against AI when a well-chosen heuristic or a clear dashboard solves the problem more cheaply and more legibly.

Data engineering capability
  • Expert SQL and strong Python; you write production code that others maintain comfortably.
  • Able to design and build ingestion and ETL/ELT independently—orchestration and transformation tooling, batch and streaming patterns, and sensible data modeling.
  • Experience in a modern warehouse or lakehouse environment (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent), including awareness of cost and performance.

Working style

Job Responsibilities

  • Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.
  • May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/Central Monitors) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.
  • Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.

  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.

jobs.title: AI Application Full Stack Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About the roleWe are building the internal AI platform that product teams across the company build on.
jobs.description:
About the role

We are building the internal AI platform that product teams across the company build on. It is the layer between our data, AI and engineering teams and the models they use, whether those come from external providers or run on our own GPUs, and through those teams it reaches thousands of businesses and millions of users.

You will own work end to end: the API, the services behind it, the data model, the interface people operate it through, the tests, and how it behaves in production under real load.

What you will do

  • Design and build secure REST APIs and real-time streaming endpoints that other engineering teams depend on daily

  • Build backend services that stay correct under concurrency, partial failure, and traffic spikes, and that hold a 99.9% availability target through peak business hours

  • Build web interfaces that make a complex system legible, so an operator can understand state and act on it without reading source code

  • Model data carefully in PostgreSQL and write queries you can defend on cost as well as correctness

  • Build and run a unified API gateway over external model providers and the self-hosted models you deploy and operate on our own GPUs, with low-latency routing, load balancing, and failover, so the teams who consume our APIs never see the differences between backends

  • Build multi-tenant boundaries that hold: authentication (OAuth2), role-based access control, quotas, and rate limits that fail closed rather than leak

  • Measure usage and cost accurately enough to report and bill from

  • Instrument what you ship, and use that instrumentation during incidents to find the real cause rather than a plausible one

  • Take part in delivery: code review, CI/CD, progressive rollout, and the debugging that follows a bad release

  • Work closely with Product Managers and the internal teams who consume the platform to turn their needs into solutions they actually adopt

  • Work with the Technical Program Manager to run the development lifecycle: concept, design, test, release, and support

  • Work closely with DevOps to operate and maintain the platform in our infrastructure

  • Keep team knowledge written down: technical requirements, API contracts, deployment notes, and post-mortems

  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar on design and code quality through review

Requirements

Engineering

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience in a team setting, building and running production web applications

  • Strong JavaScript and TypeScript, with production Node.js experience

  • Production experience with at least one modern frontend framework. Vue is preferred; React or Next.js also works, and we will expect you to become effective in Vue regardless of which you arrive with.

  • Working knowledge of Go language

  • PostgreSQL in production: schema design, indexing, transactions, and diagnosing a slow query rather than guessing at it

  • REST API design, plus practical experience with streaming responses and long-lived connections

  • Testing as part of the change rather than a later cleanup (TDD or close to it), and comfort with code review as a two-way conversation

  • Good understanding of microservices design patterns and where they cost more than they return

Production and infrastructure

  • Demonstrated ownership of scalability and reliability in high-traffic systems, including API gateways, load balancing, and operating against availability and error-rate targets

  • Security fundamentals in day-to-day work: OAuth2 and role-based access control, credential handling, tenant isolation, input validation, and least privilege

  • Docker, and container orchestration with Kubernetes and Helm

  • CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows, including release and rollback

  • A public cloud in production. Experience with Alibaba Cloud, AWS, GCP, or Azure.

AI application experience

  • You have shipped LLM-backed features to real users, not only prototypes

  • Familiarity with multiple model providers and their APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, and others), including aggregators, and an understanding of where their contracts differ in practice rather than in documentation

  • Practical grasp of streaming responses, tool and function calling, embeddings and retrieval (RAG with a vector database), multimodal input, and provider batch and file APIs

  • Experience deploying and operating self-hosted models in production (LLMs, embedding, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, or multimodal) with an inference server such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or Triton, including the trade-offs between GPU capacity, latency, and throughput

  • Experience building agent workflows that automate multi-step processes, and knowing where they need guardrails

  • Some way of telling whether model output is actually good, whether that is evaluation sets, human review, or production signals

  • Awareness of cost and latency as product constraints, not afterthoughts

  • Working proficiency with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or Codex

Collaboration and ways of working

  • Experience collaborating directly with product teams and AI engineers on technical development of features and services

  • Familiarity with Scrum and Kanban

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with a habit of sharing context with teammates and stakeholders

  • Ability to build and deploy solutions independently, from problem framing to production

Nice to have

  • Experience deploying models across multiple GPUs or multiple nodes, or fine-tuning models for a specific use case

  • Experience with microfrontend architectures (e.g. Module Federation, single-spa)

  • Experience with Ruby frameworks (e.g. Rails, Sinatra)

  • Experience building internal developer platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams

jobs.excerpt: CRA II/ SCRASyneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success.
jobs.description:
CRA II/ SCRA

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

As a Technical Product Analyst at CentralReach, you will sit within the Data Product teams, supporting Product Managers by providing the analytical and technical depth needed to translate requirements into validated, production-ready data products. You will bridge the gap between product strategy and engineering execution, ensuring that the data logic underlying our analytics offerings is as sound as the features built on top of it.

You will work closely with SQL-based data validation, requirements refinement, and process improvement, while also serving as a front-line resource for internal and external stakeholders with questions or issues related to data and dashboards. This is a hybrid role, part product execution, part data QA/validation, part process improvement, suited to someone who is comfortable owning ambiguity in data logic and wants to grow their product and analytical skill set within a fast-moving healthcare data organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with the ABI and DW Product Managers to refine requirements, define acceptance criteria, and support backlog grooming and release readiness.
  • Own SQL-based data validation and metric reconciliation, verifying source-to-target data logic and data transformation into the elasticubes.
  • Direct and interpret output from AI-agent QA tooling, designing test cases and following up on discrepancies.
  • Investigate reported data discrepancies and production issues, distinguishing upstream pipeline problems from BI-layer or presentation issues, and escalate to Engineering when appropriate.
  • Serve as the front-line owner for internal and external user questions on data and dashboards, triaging and resolving requests or routing them to the right team.
  • Support regression testing across releases, ensuring prior fixes and validated logic remain intact as new features and data sources are introduced.
  • Turn recurring manual checks into reusable, documented validation rules, and identify opportunities to automate QA and data-quality workflows.
  • Conduct market, competitive, and data-driven research on an ad hoc basis to support PM decision-making.
  • Maintain clear documentation of requirements, test cases, validation results, and known issues to build a durable artifact trail for both product teams.
  • Communicate validation findings, risk areas, and open issues clearly to PMs, Engineering, and other stakeholders, including status updates during release cycles.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a data analyst, BI analyst, QA/data validation, or technical product analyst role, ideally in a healthcare or SaaS data environment.
  • Strong proficiency in writing and reading SQL, with the ability to validate data against source-to-target logic rather than relying solely on BI-layer output.
  • Hands-on experience with BI reporting and visualization tools (e.g., Sisense, Tableau, Power BI, Looker), including building and maintaining dashboards, is required.
  • Familiarity with (or ability to quickly learn) elasticube structures and AI-agent tooling.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum development processes, including requirements refinement, backlog support, and release readiness.
  • Comfortable owning ambiguity in data logic without needing everything pre-specified, while knowing when to escalate to a PM or Engineering.
  • Strong written documentation habits, with the ability to produce clear requirements, test cases, and QA artifacts.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, able to reconcile discrepancies across multiple data sources.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical (Engineering) and non-technical (stakeholder, customer-facing) audiences.
  • Python experience is preferred but not required.
  • Prior exposure to healthcare data, EMRs, or ABA-specific data (billing, scheduling, authorization, clinical session, or clinical goals domains) is preferred but not required.
  • Process-improvement mindset, with an interest in turning recurring manual work into reusable, automated validation rules.

jobs.excerpt: About Valiantys Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity.
jobs.description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. With a strong focus on the modern workforce, the company helps customers reimagine service delivery beyond IT, streamline cross-functional workflows, and improve flow and throughput for engineering teams. For more information, visit .

Job Summary

    The Director of Delivery Operations and Workforce Planning, NoAM builds and leads the operational backbone of the regional Delivery organization across professional services and managed services. The role creates the management system, data discipline, operating cadence, and cross-functional coordination required to make delivery predictable, scalable, and financially healthy. It gives leadership a trusted, reconciled view of demand, capacity, utilization, project health, revenue, margin, and execution risk so that decisions are timely and grounded in evidence rather than anecdote.

    Working in close partnership with Delivery, Technical Delivery, Project Management, Engagement, Sales, Finance, and People & Culture, the Director turns regional strategy into repeatable operating practices and holds the organization to them. Success is measured by forecast accuracy, staffing responsiveness, utilization and margin performance, and the speed and confidence with which regional leadership can make decisions.

    This is an operations leadership role. Engagement outcomes and client delivery remain owned by the accountable Delivery, Technical Delivery, and Project Management leaders. The Director does not carry direct reports at the outset and is expected to deliver through influence, disciplined process, and clear accountability across functions.

What You'll be Working on

    Delivery Operating Model & Governance

    • Establish and maintain the NoAM Delivery operating model, including management cadences, decision forums, escalation paths, ownership structures, and recurring performance reviews

    • Create and govern a consistent sales-to-delivery-to-finance operating lifecycle covering handoff, project setup, staffing, delivery governance, change control, and closure

    • Ensure regional operating practices align with regional strategy, financial objectives, and global delivery policies, and translate those into practical workflows and standards

    • Identify systemic operational risks and recurring exceptions, distinguish isolated issues from operating-model problems, and coordinate corrective action with accountable leaders

    • Provide regional leadership with clear, consistent visibility into portfolio performance and execution health

    Demand, Capacity & Workforce Planning

    • Own the regional operating process for demand forecasting, capacity planning, utilization management, bench exposure, and forward-looking workforce visibility

    • Integrate backlog, qualified pipeline, active work, resource requests, skills and availability, and hiring plans into a single unified planning view

    • Facilitate recurring demand, capacity, and workforce reviews with Delivery, Sales, Engagement, Finance, and People & Culture leaders

    • Develop scenario analyses that surface future capacity gaps, over-allocation, bench risk, contractor needs, and cross-team deployment opportunities

    • Translate forecast demand into actionable hiring, contractor, mobility, and capability-development recommendations, and improve staffing speed through transparent prioritization and escalation

    Financial & Commercial Operations

    • Partner with Finance and Delivery leadership to maintain a reconciled operational view of services revenue, utilization, backlog health, project direct margin, and regional gross margin

    • Improve forecasting accuracy through disciplined project plans, assignments, estimates at completion, revenue phasing, and variance analysis

    • Monitor the operational indicators that reveal margin leakage and forecast risk early, including project health, write-offs, unbilled work, and billing readiness

    • Clarify root causes and facilitate corrective action planning with the accountable delivery and commercial leaders

    • Support budgeting, workforce investment, and contractor decisions with transparent assumptions and scenario analysis

    Performance Management & Decision Intelligence

    • Define and maintain the regional delivery KPI framework, including metric definitions, data ownership, thresholds, and review cadence

    • Deliver executive-ready reporting and decision narratives that connect portfolio health, demand and capacity, financial performance, and client risk

    • Analyze trends, drivers, and forecast variance to explain what is changing and why, not only what the numbers are

    • Establish trusted operating metrics by improving data quality at the source through validation, exception reporting, and clear ownership rather than manual reconciliation at reporting deadlines

    • Present leadership with concise options, implications, and recommended actions, making confidence levels and data limitations explicit

    Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution Discipline

    • Serve as the primary operating partner to the NoAM VP Delivery, converting regional priorities into executable plans and durable management routines

    • Influence alignment across Delivery, Sales, Engagement, Finance, People & Culture, and global operations without relying on formal authority

    • Clarify interfaces, decision rights, and accountability among Delivery, Technical Delivery, Project Management, Resource Management, Finance, and commercial teams

    • Promote forecasting accuracy, data discipline, and follow-through as expected operating behaviors across the region

    • Act as the regional business owner for Delivery operations requirements in PSA, CRM, and reporting platforms, setting priorities and adoption expectations in partnership with the system owners who implement them

    • Lead delivery operations resources where assigned, and build the case for additional capability as the function matures

    Experience

    • Leadership experience in delivery operations, PMO, resource management, or business operations within a professional services or consulting organization

    • Deep understanding of professional services and managed services delivery models, including project economics and the sales-to-delivery-to-finance lifecycle

    • Demonstrated experience building demand, capacity, utilization, and workforce planning processes at a regional or business-unit scale

    • Strong financial acumen, including services forecasting, budgeting, margin management, and variance analysis

    • Track record of defining KPI frameworks, improving data quality, and turning complex operational data into executive-ready decisions

    • Hands-on experience with professional services automation, CRM, and business intelligence platforms; Certinia and Salesforce experience is advantageous

    • Comfort using analytics and automation tooling to reduce administrative effort and improve forecast quality, with clear human accountability for financial and staffing decisions

    • Strong executive communication, facilitation, and stakeholder influence skills, with the ability to align leaders around facts, trade-offs, and ownership

    • Ability to operate at both strategic and detailed levels: designing the operating model while ensuring the data, controls, and follow-through work in practice

To Succeed in this Role, you Bring:

    • Significant leadership experience in consulting, professional services, delivery, or managed services environments

    • Proven experience leading multi-level delivery teams across project-based work and ongoing services

    • Significant experience leading delivery within complex, large-scale enterprise transformation programs involving multiple workstreams, stakeholder groups, and delivery teams, with exposure to strategy, roadmap development, governance, execution, and value realization

    • Deep domain expertise in at least one of the following: IT Service Management (ITSM), Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), or Project, Program, and Portfolio Management (PPPM), with demonstrated experience applying that expertise to shape solutions and achieve meaningful client outcomes

    • Proven experience operating within or alongside enterprise PMO and portfolio-governance structures, including integrated planning, dependency management, RAID governance, executive reporting, and decision forums

    • Demonstrated commercial acumen, with experience providing delivery input into opportunity shaping, scoping, estimation, SOW review, margin considerations, account expansion, and commercial-risk decisions

    • Track record of leading high-stakes client escalations and recovery plans while balancing client outcomes, contractual and commercial commitments, delivery risk, and organizational capacity

    • Strong executive presence and stakeholder-management skills, with experience influencing senior client leaders and aligning stakeholders around difficult transformation and delivery decisions

    • Comfortable leading through ambiguity, incomplete information, and competing priorities, using sound judgment to establish direction, make timely decisions, and create clarity for clients and teams

    • Experience improving utilization, margin, forecasting, delivery consistency, and scalable operating practices

    • Experience delivering transformations enabled by Atlassian or comparable enterprise platforms, with a strong understanding of how technology, operating models, processes, and organizational change combine to achieve measurable business outcomes

    • Practical understanding of AI-enabled delivery, automation, and analytics, including responsible adoption and appropriate human oversight

    • Demonstrated success developing leaders, coaching teams, building organizational capability, and fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture

    Your team and partners:

  • NoAM VP Delivery (your line manager)
  • Delivery Managers and Managed Services Managers
  • Delivery and Managed Services Consultants and Associate Consultants
  • Engagement Directors and Sales leaders
  • Transformation (Tx), Solution, and Technical leaders
  • Regional and cross-functional leadership partners

Why you Should Apply?

    Our team members are our greatest asset and we work hard to ensure that Valiantys is not only a great place to work, but also a platform for you to grow.

    Sense. We're committed to giving you the level of information you need to make sense of your assignments. You will witness the impact of your actions.

    Training. We will provide you with the necessary time and budget to help you develop your skills and continue to build your career.

    Flexibility. We understand that life is all about balance and we offer you the flexibility and support to help you maintain balance across the different pillars of your life.

  • Competitive compensation with an annual performance-based bonus

Sr. Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Mutual of Omaha is seeking Platform Engineers who are passionate about modernizing enterprise infrastructure, solving complex technical challenges, and helping shape the future of the platforms that power our business.

The organization is actively modernizing enterprise infrastructure through initiatives spanning platform engineering, automation, storage modernization, resiliency, and OpenShift Virtualization. Engineers in this role will help design, build, and support the infrastructure services and platform capabilities required to meet current and future business needs.

This position offers the opportunity to help shape the future direction of enterprise infrastructure through modernization, automation, and platform engineering initiatives.

We welcome engineers who bring meaningful depth in one or more infrastructure disciplines and the ability to learn, adapt, and grow across a diverse set of technologies. Candidates are not expected to have expertise in every technology within the portfolio.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary (Levels have variable responsibilities and qualifications)
      • Engineer II: $130,000-$140,000 plus annual bonus opportunity
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Help design, engineer, and modernize enterprise infrastructure platforms and services supporting critical business applications.
